affiliations: Ghent University

detail.title: The Rise of the 1% and the Fall of the Labor Share: An Automation-Driven Doom Loop?

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: I evaluate the link between automation and the rise in top income concentration when inequality matters for macro. The novel mechanism is that automation redistributes income towards high-wealth households who save more, which lowers the interest rate and incites firms to automate more. To operationalize this, I build a tractable heterogeneous-agent model (1) with wealth in the utility function as a luxury good, and (2) a firm-side choice on automation. I find that introducing realistic savings rate heterogeneity largely eliminates the need for ad hoc technology shifts. Rather, automation is the outcome of increased top income concentration, not just its driver.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动化与顶层收入集中度上升之间的关系，发现两者存在双向因果关系：自动化导致收入向高财富家庭集中，而收入集中又通过降低利率进一步促进自动化。
AI.research_question: 自动化与顶层收入集中度上升之间有何联系？两者是单向因果关系还是相互强化？
AI.motivation: 理解自动化如何影响收入不平等，以及不平等如何反过来影响自动化决策，这对于解释现代经济中顶层收入集中度上升的现象至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 财富作为奢侈品进入效用函数；2) 企业层面的自动化选择；3) 异质性代理人模型；4) 储蓄率异质性对利率和自动化决策的影响。
AI.method: 构建一个可处理的异质性代理人模型，包含财富作为奢侈品的效用函数和企业自动化选择，通过模型分析自动化与收入集中度的双向关系。
AI.findings: 引入现实的储蓄率异质性后，无需依赖特殊的技术冲击就能解释自动化现象。自动化既是顶层收入集中的原因，也是其结果，两者形成相互强化的循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了自动化与收入不平等之间的双向因果关系理论框架，解释了为何自动化既是收入集中的原因也是结果，为理解现代经济不平等提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解自动化与不平等关系的分析框架，表明单纯的技术冲击解释可能不充分，需要考虑收入分配对技术采纳的反向影响。

title: AI for Incentive-Compatible Insurance Design: Learning Optimal Indemnity with Lipschitz Networks
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE),  and Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: AI for Incentive-Compatible Insurance Design: Learning Optimal Indemnity with Lipschitz Networks
detail.abstract: Many optimal insurance design problems with the incentive-compatible (IC) condition lack closed-form solutions and efficient numerical methods. This paper proposes a novel algorithm to obtain numerical  solutions of optimal insurance by parameterizing the indemnity function using a Lipschitz Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) architecture. To incorporate the principle of indemnity and  the IC condition, we introduce constrained affine transformation layers and a special activation function while preserving the MLP’s universal approximation. We provide a theoretical justification for the proposed architecture and develop a gradient-based algorithm that efficiently approximates optimal indemnity functions with very high accuracy. We validate the algorithm’s accuracy against classical benchmarks with known analytical solutions, and demonstrate its applicability to several economically important yet previously intractable settings including optimal insurance with a dependent background risk, loss ambiguity, or rank-dependent utility. A case study on Florida hurricane insurance further illustrates how derived optimal contracts can mitigate the crowding-out effect of government relief to enhance welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用Lipschitz多层感知机参数化保险赔偿函数的新算法，用于求解带有激励相容条件的最优保险设计问题。该算法能高效近似最优赔偿函数，并应用于依赖背景风险、损失模糊性、等级依赖效用等复杂经济场景。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种高效算法来数值求解带有激励相容条件的最优保险设计问题，特别是那些缺乏解析解的传统方法难以处理的情况？
AI.motivation: 许多带有激励相容条件的最优保险设计问题缺乏闭式解和有效的数值方法，这限制了理论模型在实际复杂经济环境中的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优保险设计理论、激励相容原理、赔偿原则、神经网络近似理论、Lipschitz连续函数理论
AI.method: 提出使用Lipschitz多层感知机参数化保险赔偿函数，引入约束仿射变换层和特殊激活函数来满足赔偿原则和激励相容条件，开发基于梯度的算法高效近似最优赔偿函数
AI.findings: 算法在已知解析解的经典基准测试中表现出高精度，能够处理依赖背景风险、损失模糊性、等级依赖效用等传统方法难以处理的经济重要场景，佛罗里达飓风保险案例研究表明最优合同可以减轻政府救济的挤出效应并提高福利
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了满足保险赔偿原则和激励相容条件的神经网络架构理论；2) 证明了该架构的通用近似能力；3) 为复杂最优保险设计问题提供了新的数值求解框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了高效的最优保险设计数值算法；2) 能够处理实际中重要的复杂保险场景；3) 为政策制定者设计更有效的保险机制提供了工具，如减轻政府救济的挤出效应

reference: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1173; https://doi.org/10.59576/sr.1173
title: Less for You, More for Me: Credit Reallocation and Rationing Under Usury Limits
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Economics, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Less for You, More for Me: Credit Reallocation and Rationing Under Usury Limits

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of New York Staff Report No. 1173
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many states have capped consumer loan interest rates to protect households from high-cost lenders. Using triple-difference and event study analysis, we investigate how these usury limits affect the availability and allocation of credit across households. Consistent with standard price theory, we find that credit to the riskiest borrowers contracts under usury limits without improving delinquencies. More surprisingly, credit to lower risk borrowers expands under usury limits. This reallocation suggests that usury limits have unintended effects that are not entirely explained by standard theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究高利贷限制对信贷市场的影响，发现利率上限导致高风险借款人信贷收缩，但低风险借款人信贷反而扩张，这种重新分配效应超出传统价格理论的预期。
AI.research_question: 高利贷限制（利率上限）如何影响信贷的可得性和在不同风险类型家庭之间的分配？
AI.motivation: 许多州实施消费者贷款利率上限以保护家庭免受高成本贷款机构的侵害，但这些政策对信贷市场分配效应的实际影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准价格理论（供给需求框架），但研究发现有超出传统理论解释的效应。
AI.method: 三重差分法（triple-difference）和事件研究分析（event study analysis）。
AI.findings: 1. 高风险借款人的信贷在高利贷限制下收缩，且违约率没有改善；2. 低风险借款人的信贷反而扩张；3. 这种重新分配效应表明高利贷限制具有超出标准理论预期的意外后果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了高利贷限制对信贷分配的复杂影响，挑战了传统价格理论的简单预测，表明需要更复杂的理论框架来解释信贷市场的政策干预效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于利率上限政策实际效果的实证证据，表明这类政策可能产生意想不到的分配效应，需要在政策设计中考虑这些复杂影响。

title: The Wealth of Civilization: A General Theory of Capital, Welfare and the Economics of Time
affiliations: America First Policy Institute (AFPI)

detail.title: The Wealth of Civilization: A General Theory of Capital, Welfare and the Economics of Time
detail.abstract:
The Wealth of Civilization offers a rethinking of modern economics through the lens it has most persistently mishandled: time. Drawing on insights from neoclassical, Austrian, Keynesian, and welfare economics, this book develops a unified framework for understanding value, cost, capital, and policy in a world that unfolds dynamically rather than instantaneously.

At its core is a simple but radical claim. Long-run prosperity is governed not by static efficiency or momentary equilibrium, but by the accumulation and stewardship of capital across generations. Markets excel at allocating resources in the present, yet systematically underinvest in the future. This intertemporal gap—driven by time preference, missing markets, and mismeasured opportunity costs—constitutes the most consequential market failure of all.

The book revisits foundational concepts that economists often treat as settled, including opportunity cost, surplus, discounting, externalities, and social welfare. It argues that costs are objective but dynamic, that surplus is heterogeneous and intertemporal, and that welfare cannot be understood without explicit attention to investment, compounding, and bequests. Building on these insights, it reframes cost-benefit analysis, critiques conventional approaches to inflation adjustment and value-of-life estimation, and shows why static reasoning obscures the forces that shape civilization’s long-run trajectory.

The result is neither a defense of laissez-faire nor an apology for central planning. Instead, The Wealth of Civilization advances a pragmatic vision in which markets remain indispensable, but properly designed public institutions play an indispensable role as custodians of intergenerational welfare. Written for economists, policymakers, and intellectually curious readers alike, the book avoids technical formalism in favor of conceptual clarity, offering a general theory suited to the economic challenges of the twenty-first century.

AI.tldr: 本书重新思考现代经济学，强调时间维度的重要性，认为长期繁荣取决于跨代资本积累，市场在资源配置上表现优异但系统性低估未来投资，提出需要公共机构作为跨代福利守护者的实用主义框架。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的理论框架来理解动态世界中的价值、成本、资本和政策，以解决市场在跨代资源配置上的系统性失败？
AI.motivation: 现代经济学在处理时间维度上存在系统性缺陷，忽视了长期繁荣取决于跨代资本积累这一核心问题，导致对市场失败的根本原因理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合新古典经济学、奥地利学派、凯恩斯主义和福利经济学的见解，构建动态时间框架，重新定义机会成本、剩余、贴现、外部性和社会福利等核心概念。
AI.method: 采用概念分析和理论重构的方法，避免技术形式主义，通过重新审视经济学基础概念来构建统一的理论框架。
AI.findings: 1. 长期繁荣由跨代资本积累决定而非静态效率；2. 市场在资源配置上表现优异但系统性低估未来投资；3. 时间偏好、缺失市场和对机会成本的错误衡量导致跨代市场失败；4. 成本是客观但动态的，剩余是异质且跨期的；5. 社会福利必须考虑投资、复利和遗产传递。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出统一的动态时间经济学框架；2. 重新定义机会成本、剩余、贴现等核心概念；3. 识别跨代市场失败为最重要的市场失灵；4. 构建考虑投资、复利和遗产的社会福利理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 重构成本效益分析方法；2. 批判传统通胀调整和生命价值估算方法；3. 提出市场与公共机构协同的实用主义政策框架；4. 为21世纪经济挑战提供理论指导。

title: SOFR so Good: Transaction Costs and Resilience in the Post-Libor Swap Market
affiliations: and Copenhagen Business School

detail.title: SOFR so Good: Transaction Costs and Resilience in the Post-Libor Swap Market
detail.abstract: Using novel transaction and quote data, we find that transaction costs in the SOFR swap market are low on average, but somewhat higher for dealer-to-client than interdealer trades partly reflecting differences in (permanent) price impact. Costs vary systematically with trade characteristics and market conditions, but this does not explain cost differences across market segments. Average swap execution costs are moderately higher than the minimum cost of trading on-the-run Treasuries on the main limit-order book, yet a substantial share of swap trades achieve cheaper execution. During recent crises, both transaction costs and trading activity increase sharply, providing a mixed picture of market resilience. However, based on comparable measures of volatility, trading activity, and liquidity stress, we conclude that the swap market appears more resilient than the Treasury market.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用SOFR互换市场的新型交易和报价数据，发现交易成本平均较低，但交易商对客户的成本高于交易商间交易，部分反映了永久价格影响的差异。成本随交易特征和市场条件系统变化，但这无法解释市场细分间的成本差异。互换执行成本平均略高于国债市场最低成本，但相当一部分互换交易实现了更便宜的执行。在危机期间，交易成本和交易活动都急剧增加，显示出市场韧性的混合图景。然而，基于可比较的波动性、交易活动和流动性压力指标，互换市场比国债市场更具韧性。
AI.research_question: SOFR互换市场的交易成本特征是什么？这些成本如何在不同市场细分（交易商间vs交易商对客户）之间变化？与国债市场相比，互换市场的执行成本和韧性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着SOFR成为主要的参考利率，了解SOFR互换市场的交易成本和市场韧性对于市场参与者、监管机构和政策制定者至关重要。现有研究对互换市场交易成本的了解有限，特别是在不同市场细分和危机期间的韧性表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论，特别是交易成本分析、价格影响理论和市场韧性框架。研究考虑了永久价格影响、交易特征（如规模、方向）和市场条件对交易成本的影响。
AI.method: 使用新型的SOFR互换市场交易和报价数据，分析交易成本在不同市场细分（交易商间vs交易商对客户）的差异。采用回归分析检验成本与交易特征、市场条件的关系。与国债市场进行比较分析，使用可比较的波动性、交易活动和流动性压力指标评估市场韧性。
AI.findings:
1. SOFR互换市场交易成本平均较低，但交易商对客户的成本高于交易商间交易，部分反映了永久价格影响的差异。
2. 成本随交易特征和市场条件系统变化，但这无法完全解释市场细分间的成本差异。
3. 互换执行成本平均略高于国债市场最低成本，但相当一部分互换交易实现了更便宜的执行。
4. 在危机期间，交易成本和交易活动都急剧增加，显示出市场韧性的混合图景。
5. 基于可比较指标，互换市场比国债市场更具韧性。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次系统分析了SOFR互换市场的交易成本结构。
2. 揭示了不同市场细分间交易成本的系统性差异及其驱动因素。
3. 扩展了市场韧性理论在互换市场的应用，提供了与国债市场的比较视角。
4. 深化了对永久价格影响在不同市场结构中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为市场参与者提供了SOFR互换交易成本的基准信息，有助于交易决策。
2. 帮助监管机构评估互换市场的效率和韧性，特别是在危机时期。
3. 为政策制定者提供了关于参考利率转换后市场功能的实证证据。
4. 为交易成本管理和执行策略提供了实用指导。

title: Taxing Better: Using AI to Advance Democracy
affiliations: King's College London - The Dickson Poon School of Law

detail.title: Taxing Better: Using AI to Advance Democracy

declarations.ethicsApproval: Minimal risk application (MRA-24/25-47704) approved by King's College London.
declarations.funderStatement: This policy paper emanates from a project has been generously funded by the British Academy and Leverhulme Trust Small Research Grant Scheme 2024-25 (grant nr SRG2425\251209) and took place between May and November 2025.

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a threat to democratic norms. Machine learning bots have been used by malign forces to disrupt democratic processes. The literature as a result is replete with warnings! The goal of this project is to turn the threat that AI poses on its head: to use AI to advance democratic norms. This is not about the efficiency benefits that AI will produce, often lauded in contradistinction to AI’s problems. There are very important values that can be fostered by AI. To improve democratic participation and render the tax system more legitimate in the UK, this report makes 5 recommendations for the use of AI in the tax system.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨如何利用AI促进民主规范，特别是在税收系统中应用AI来改善民主参与和增强税收系统的合法性，提出了5项具体建议。
AI.research_question: 如何利用人工智能（AI）来促进民主规范，特别是在税收系统中应用AI来改善民主参与和增强税收系统的合法性？
AI.motivation: 当前AI常被视为对民主规范的威胁，常被恶意力量用于破坏民主进程。但作者认为AI也可以用来促进民主价值观，而不仅仅是提高效率。需要探索如何将AI从威胁转变为促进民主的工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主理论、AI伦理、公共管理理论、税收合法性理论、技术与社会互动理论。
AI.method: 政策分析报告方法，基于文献综述和理论分析，提出具体政策建议。报告形式，提出5项具体建议。
AI.findings: AI可以用于促进民主价值观，特别是在税收系统中。报告提出了5项具体建议来利用AI改善民主参与和增强税收系统的合法性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI从"威胁"框架重新概念化为"促进民主的工具"；2. 拓展了AI在公共管理领域的应用理论；3. 提出了AI促进民主规范的理论框架；4. 连接了技术发展与民主价值观的理论关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为英国税收系统提供了5项具体的AI应用建议；2. 为政策制定者提供了将AI用于促进民主的实践指南；3. 展示了AI在增强税收系统合法性方面的具体应用路径；4. 为其他民主国家提供了可借鉴的AI应用模式。

title: Energy supply chain resilience under geopolitical disruption: Assessing global and Red Sea oil tanker networks
affiliations: Shanghai Maritime University, ,  and

detail.title: Energy supply chain resilience under geopolitical disruption: Assessing global and Red Sea oil tanker networks
detail.abstract: The Red Sea crisis exemplifies how regional geopolitical disruptions propagate through energy seaborne transportation system. This study develops an integrated dual-indicator framework to assess resilience of the global oil tanker network and its Red Sea subnetwork during this ongoing crisis. The static resilience index conducts targeted attack-recovery simulations across five strategies. Dynamically, we monitor resilience index using monthly network data, employing Granger causality tests to identify transmission mechanisms from shocks. Results reveal four key findings:First, the Red Sea's ports are characterized by dense concentration in the north and sparse distribution in the south. Although the conflict has continued for a considerable period,  two networks have not yet recovered to its pre-crisis level. Second, the impact of subnetwork on the global network reflects a typical “early-intensified and later-attenuated” pattern. Furthermore, oil tanker transportation systems are highly dependent on bottleneck corridors and key ports of cross-regional traffic flows. Third, exogenous shocks influence network resilience primarily through oil price fluctuations and operational adjustments. Endogenous factors affect two networks in distinct ways. Granger causality tests further reveal a bidirectional feedback relationship between the global system and the Red Sea subnetwork. Fourth, critical infrastructure analysis indicates that the north-south channels of the Red Sea plays a dominant role in the oil transportation system, whereas ports located in the central Red Sea play a comparatively minor role. These findings advance maritime resilience theory by operationalizing hierarchical network relationships and provide actionable strategies for enhancing energy supply chain stability under geopolitical uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了双指标框架评估红海危机期间全球油轮网络及其子网络的韧性，发现网络未恢复至危机前水平，冲击呈现"先强后弱"模式，油价波动和运营调整是主要传导机制，红海南北通道在石油运输中起主导作用。
AI.research_question: 区域地缘政治破坏如何通过能源海运系统传播？全球油轮网络及其红海子网络在持续危机中的韧性表现如何？
AI.motivation: 红海危机展示了地缘政治中断如何影响能源海运系统，需要系统评估全球油轮网络的韧性，为能源供应链稳定提供策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 海运韧性理论、网络韧性理论、层级网络关系理论、冲击传导机制理论。
AI.method: 开发集成双指标框架：静态韧性指数（五种策略的针对性攻击-恢复模拟）和动态韧性监测（月度网络数据，格兰杰因果检验识别冲击传导机制）。
AI.findings: 1. 红海港口北密南疏，网络未恢复至危机前水平；2. 子网络对全球网络影响呈"先强后弱"模式，系统依赖瓶颈走廊和关键港口；3. 外生冲击主要通过油价波动和运营调整影响韧性，内生因素影响方式不同，全球系统与红海子网络存在双向反馈；4. 红海南北通道主导石油运输，中部港口作用较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过操作化层级网络关系推进海运韧性理论，深化对地缘政治冲击下网络韧性动态的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为增强地缘政治不确定性下的能源供应链稳定提供可操作策略，识别关键基础设施和冲击传导机制，帮助决策者制定针对性应对措施。

title: If the utility function is unbounded, any finite utility assignment to the St Petersburg game is consistent with expected utility theory
affiliations: University of Edinburgh - Usher Institute

detail.title: If the utility function is unbounded, any finite utility assignment to the St Petersburg game is consistent with expected utility theory
detail.abstract: The von Neumann Morgenstern theorem gives necessary and sufficient conditions for a binary relation on a convex subset of probability measures to be represented by a linear functional on the vector space of signed measures. Unbounded utility functions do not provide enough data to determine the representing functional. This requires specifying utility values on a Hamel basis of the vector space of signed measures, which may be non-constructive. Extending by continuity and truncation continuity can enlarge the domain where the expected utility representation is valid, but not to probability measures that have undefined expected utility. Utility values can thus be freely assigned to any linearly independent set of probability measures whose expected utility is not defined. In particular, any finite utility value assignment to the St Petersburg, Pasadena and related games is consistent with expected utility theory.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦定理在无界效用函数情况下的局限性，指出无界效用函数无法唯一确定表示泛函，需要指定在符号测度向量空间的Hamel基上的效用值，这可能是非构造性的。论文证明任何对圣彼得堡、帕萨迪纳及相关博弈的有限效用值分配都与期望效用理论一致。
AI.research_question: 在无界效用函数情况下，冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦定理的表示泛函如何确定？特别是对于圣彼得堡、帕萨迪纳等期望效用未定义的博弈，效用值分配是否与期望效用理论一致？
AI.motivation: 冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦定理为概率测度凸子集上的二元关系提供了期望效用表示的充要条件，但对于无界效用函数，该表示泛函无法唯一确定。这在实际应用中（如圣彼得堡悖论相关博弈）产生了理论困难，需要澄清无界效用函数情况下期望效用理论的适用范围和限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦定理、期望效用理论、线性泛函表示理论、符号测度向量空间、Hamel基理论、无界效用函数理论
AI.method: 理论分析方法，基于线性泛函理论和向量空间理论，分析无界效用函数情况下期望效用表示的存在性和唯一性问题。通过Hamel基的构造和线性扩展方法，探讨表示泛函的确定方式。
AI.findings: 1. 无界效用函数无法提供足够数据唯一确定表示泛函；2. 需要指定在符号测度向量空间的Hamel基上的效用值，这可能涉及非构造性选择；3. 通过连续性和截断连续性扩展可以扩大期望效用表示的有效域，但不能扩展到期望效用未定义的概率测度；4. 对于期望效用未定义的概率测度，可以自由分配效用值给任何线性独立的测度集合；5. 特别地，对圣彼得堡、帕萨迪纳及相关博弈的任何有限效用值分配都与期望效用理论一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 阐明了冯·诺依曼-摩根斯坦定理在无界效用函数情况下的局限性；2. 提供了确定表示泛函所需的Hamel基方法；3. 证明了期望效用理论对圣彼得堡悖论等相关博弈的效用值分配具有包容性；4. 扩展了期望效用表示理论在无界效用函数情况下的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为处理圣彼得堡悖论等经典决策理论问题提供了理论依据；2. 帮助决策理论研究者理解无界效用函数情况下期望效用模型的适用范围；3. 为实际决策分析中处理期望效用未定义的情况提供了理论指导；4. 澄清了期望效用理论对特定博弈效用值分配的灵活性。

title: Recognizing Seasonal Patterns in UV-B Data: A Deep Learning and SARIMA Comparison
affiliations: , , ,  and

detail.title: Recognizing Seasonal Patterns in UV-B Data: A Deep Learning and SARIMA Comparison

keywords.keywords: UV-B forecasting SARIMA LSTM Informer Transformer Prophet Time series

detail.abstract: In this paper, we evaluate various time series forecasting models such as LSTM, bidirectional LSTM, Facebook Prophet, Transformer, Informer, and SARIMA in order to capture fluctuation patterns of UV-B. In order to compare the performance of each prediction method, the root mean square error (RMSE) and the mean absolute error (MAE) between the observed UV-B values and the predicted one were computed. Consequently, Informer shows the best highest prediction accuracy among all methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了多种时间序列预测模型（LSTM、双向LSTM、Facebook Prophet、Transformer、Informer、SARIMA）在UV-B波动模式预测中的性能，发现Informer模型在所有方法中具有最高的预测精度。
AI.research_question: 哪种时间序列预测模型（LSTM、双向LSTM、Facebook Prophet、Transformer、Informer、SARIMA）在预测UV-B波动模式方面表现最佳？
AI.motivation: 需要准确预测UV-B辐射的波动模式，这对于环境监测、健康风险评估和农业应用等领域具有重要意义。不同时间序列模型在UV-B预测中的性能比较尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列预测理论，包括深度学习模型（LSTM、Transformer架构）、传统统计模型（SARIMA）和混合方法（Facebook Prophet）。
AI.method: 采用实证比较研究方法，使用多个时间序列预测模型对UV-B数据进行预测，通过计算RMSE和MAE指标来评估各模型的预测精度。
AI.findings: Informer模型在所有评估的方法中表现出最高的预测精度，其RMSE和MAE值均优于其他模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 为时间序列预测领域提供了Informer模型在环境数据（特别是UV-B辐射）预测中的有效性证据，扩展了Transformer架构在环境科学中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境监测机构和研究人员提供了选择UV-B预测模型的实用指导，推荐使用Informer模型以获得最准确的预测结果。

title: An Analysis of Interim Resolution Professional; Issues and Challenges
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: An Analysis of Interim Resolution Professional; Issues and Challenges

keywords: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI)

detail.abstract: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (IBC) revolutionized India’s insolvency regime by introducing a time-bound, creditor-centric resolution framework. At the heart of this process lies the Interim Resolution Professional (IRP), entrusted with the responsibility of managing the corporate debtor’s affairs from the initiation of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) until the appointment of the Resolution Professional (RP). This paper critically examines the evolving role, powers, and challenges faced by IRPs between 2016 and 2025, against the backdrop of legislative, judicial, and regulatory developments. It explores key amendments enhancing IRP independence through panel-based appointments, stricter disclosures, and quasi-judicial powers; judicial interpretations clarifying their autonomy, liability, and fiduciary duties; and regulatory reforms by the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) focusing on standardization of fees, conflict-of-interest management, and enhanced accountability. The study also highlights technological interventions such as e-filing, Information Utilities, and centralized auction platforms reshaping insolvency practice. Despite these progressive reforms, IRPs continue to encounter operational hurdles including promoter non-cooperation, delayed remuneration, and overlapping liabilities. The paper concludes by proposing recommendations for strengthening institutional support, digital integration, and statutory protections to ensure efficient, transparent, and equitable insolvency resolution aligned with global best practices.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了印度《破产与破产法》中临时破产解决专业人员的角色演变、权力和挑战，探讨了2016-2025年间的立法、司法和监管改革，并提出了加强制度支持、数字整合和法定保护的建议。
AI.research_question: 在2016-2025年间，印度《破产与破产法》框架下临时破产解决专业人员的角色、权力和挑战如何演变？
AI.motivation: 《破产与破产法》改革了印度的破产制度，而临时破产解决专业人员是该过程的核心角色。需要系统研究其在立法、司法和监管发展背景下的演变，以评估改革效果并识别持续挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 破产法理论、公司治理理论、委托代理理论、制度经济学理论
AI.method: 文献分析、案例研究、政策分析、历史分析（2016-2025年期间）
AI.findings:
1. 立法改革增强了IRP独立性（小组任命、更严格披露、准司法权力）
2. 司法解释明确了IRP的自主权、责任和信托义务
3. 监管改革标准化了费用、利益冲突管理和问责制
4. 技术干预（电子申报、信息工具、集中拍卖平台）重塑了破产实践
5. 持续存在的操作障碍：发起人不合作、报酬延迟、责任重叠
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 丰富了发展中国家破产制度演变的实证研究
2. 深化了对破产专业人员角色和责任的制度分析
3. 提供了法律改革与实施差距的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供加强IRP制度支持的具体建议
2. 为破产专业人员提供操作指南和最佳实践
3. 为企业利益相关者提供破产程序透明度的改进方向
4. 为国际破产制度比较研究提供印度案例

title: Governance and Accountability of Regional-Owned Enterprises (BUMD) in Public-Private Partnership (KPBU) Drinking Water Infrastructure Projects in Indonesia
affiliations: Sekolah Tinggi Ilmu Ekonomi (STIE)

detail.title: Governance and Accountability of Regional-Owned Enterprises (BUMD) in Public-Private Partnership (KPBU) Drinking Water Infrastructure Projects in Indonesia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest related to this research. There is no personal, commercial, or financial relationship that could be perceived to influence the findings presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects, experiments, interviews, or surveys. Therefore, ethics approval was not required. The research relied solely on secondary data from publicly available documents, academic literature, official government publications, and credible news sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was fully self-funded by the author. No external funding support was received from any organization or institution.

detail.abstract: This study aims to analyze the governance and accountability challenges faced by Regional-Owned Enterprises (BUMD) as the Project Responsible Party (PJPK) in public-private partnership infrastructure projects, with a case study on the Bandar Lampung Drinking Water Supply System (SPAM). Sustainable and adequate drinking water services are fundamental to human well-being and are integral to achieving Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6). In Indonesia, the Government-Business Partnership (KPBU) scheme has been implemented to overcome budgetary constraints and expand service coverage. However, the SPAM Bandar Lampung project has faced issues related to transparency, internal control, and risk allocation between the government and BUMD/PJPK. This study employs a qualitative approach using document analysis, academic literature, and project reports as primary data sources. The findings indicate that the success of KPBU implementation depends heavily on clear governance structures, strong accountability mechanisms, and effective coordination among stakeholders. Additionally, the institutional capacity of BUMD as PJPK, the culture of accountability, and external oversight are critical factors in preventing mismanagement and ensuring service sustainability. This research contributes theoretically to the literature on public-private partnerships and public sector governance while providing practical implications for policy strengthening, transparency, and project management in regional water infrastructure initiatives.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了区域国有企业作为PPP项目负责方在基础设施项目中的治理与问责挑战，以班达楠榜供水系统为案例。研究发现KPBU成功实施依赖于清晰的治理结构、强有力的问责机制和利益相关者间的有效协调。
AI.research_question: 区域国有企业作为项目负责方在公私合作伙伴关系基础设施项目中面临哪些治理与问责挑战？
AI.motivation: 可持续的饮用水服务对人类福祉至关重要，是实现可持续发展目标6的关键。印尼政府通过政府-企业伙伴关系方案克服预算限制并扩大服务覆盖范围，但班达楠榜供水项目在透明度、内部控制和风险分配方面存在问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公私合作伙伴关系理论、公共部门治理理论、问责机制理论、利益相关者协调理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法，使用文件分析、学术文献和项目报告作为主要数据来源
AI.findings: KPBU实施成功高度依赖于清晰的治理结构、强有力的问责机制和利益相关者间的有效协调；区域国有企业作为项目负责方的机构能力、问责文化和外部监督是防止管理不善和确保服务可持续性的关键因素
AI.theory_contributions: 对公私合作伙伴关系和公共部门治理文献的理论贡献，深化了对PPP项目中治理结构和问责机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策强化、透明度提升和区域水基础设施项目管理提供实践启示，有助于改善PPP项目的实施效果

title: In Search of the Causal Greenium
affiliations: WU Vienna University of Economics and Business,  and Reykjavik University

detail.title: In Search of the Causal Greenium
detail.abstract: We propose a regression discontinuity design to determine whether there is a difference in the expected returns of green versus brown securities (greenium). We analyze daily changes in option-implied expected returns following the outcome of close vote ecology-related shareholder proposals to estimate the causal impact of a small change in investors' aggregate greenness perception on expected returns. Upon proposals' passage, expected returns with a forecast horizon of 365 (730) days drop by approximately 7.2% (9.6%) relative to proposals' failure, indicating the existence of a negative greenium in US equity markets. We introduce a battery of fixed effects, account for multiple periods around shareholder proposal voting dates, and remove confounding governance and social proposals, and find that our results are robust in these specifications.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用断点回归设计分析绿色证券与棕色证券的预期回报差异（绿色溢价），发现美国股市存在负向绿色溢价，即绿色证券的预期回报低于棕色证券。
AI.research_question: 绿色证券与棕色证券之间是否存在预期回报差异（绿色溢价）？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资日益重要，理解绿色证券是否具有不同的风险回报特征对投资者和政策制定者至关重要。现有研究对绿色溢价的存在和方向存在争议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论和投资者偏好理论，如果投资者偏好绿色资产，可能愿意接受较低回报，导致负向绿色溢价。
AI.method: 使用断点回归设计，分析生态相关股东提案投票结果前后期权隐含预期回报的日度变化，估计投资者绿色感知微小变化对预期回报的因果影响。
AI.findings: 提案通过后，365天（730天）预测期的预期回报相对于提案失败下降约7.2%（9.6%），表明美国股市存在负向绿色溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为绿色溢价的存在和方向提供了因果证据，支持投资者偏好影响资产定价的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ESG投资者提供投资决策依据，帮助理解绿色投资的风险回报特征，对资产配置和风险管理有实际意义。

title: The Role of Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) in Financing the Probolinggo-Banyuwangi Toll Road Development: A Perspective on Efficiency and Sustainability
affiliations: Sekolah Tinggi Ilmu Ekonomi Indonesia Jakarta

detail.title: The Role of Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) in Financing the Probolinggo-Banyuwangi Toll Road Development: A Perspective on Efficiency and Sustainability
detail.abstract: This study aims to analyze the role of Public Private Partnership (PPP) in financing the construction of the Probolinggo-Banyuwangi Toll Road from the perspectives of efficiency and sustainability. The research employs a descriptive qualitative method using a literature study approach, focusing on an in-depth analysis of previous studies, government policies, and official documents related to PPP implementation in toll road infrastructure projects. The findings indicate that the application of PPP in the Probolinggo-Banyuwangi Toll Road project significantly contributes to financing efficiency through proportional risk-sharing between the government and the private sector, while also accelerating project completion without heavily burdening the state budget. From the sustainability perspective, the project demonstrates positive impacts on regional economic growth and connectivity improvement, although challenges remain in addressing social and environmental issues. The study concludes that PPP serves as a strategic instrument for supporting sustainable infrastructure financing in Indonesia, but its effectiveness depends on transparent governance, strong regulatory oversight, and the integration of sustainability principles throughout the planning and implementation stages.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了PPP在Probolinggo-Banyuwangi收费公路建设融资中的作用，发现PPP通过风险分担提高了融资效率并加速了项目完成，同时促进了区域经济增长和连通性改善，但社会和环境挑战仍需解决。
AI.research_question: PPP在Probolinggo-Banyuwangi收费公路建设融资中如何发挥效率与可持续性作用？
AI.motivation: 探讨PPP作为基础设施融资模式的潜力，特别是在印尼收费公路项目中如何平衡效率与可持续发展需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公私合作伙伴关系理论、基础设施融资理论、可持续发展理论、风险分担理论。
AI.method: 描述性定性方法，采用文献研究法，深入分析先前研究、政府政策和PPP在收费公路基础设施项目中的官方文件。
AI.findings: 1. PPP通过政府与私营部门之间的比例风险分担显著提高了融资效率；2. 在不严重增加国家预算负担的情况下加速了项目完成；3. 对区域经济增长和连通性改善有积极影响；4. 社会和环境问题仍面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了PPP在发展中国家基础设施融资中的理论理解，特别是风险分担机制与可持续发展目标的整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼及其他发展中国家提供了PPP实施的最佳实践建议，强调透明治理、强有力的监管监督以及可持续发展原则在规划与实施阶段的整合。

title: Fiscal Spending News, the Cost of Capital, and Corporate Investment
affiliations: University of Wisconsin - Madison - Department of Finance, Investment and Banking, Study Center Gerensee and

detail.title: Fiscal Spending News, the Cost of Capital, and Corporate Investment
detail.abstract: We revisit the effect of government spending on corporate investment. Employing a narrative approach to identify exogenous variation in government expenditures (Ramey, 2011b; Ramey and Zubairy, 2018), we find that a one-percentage-point increase in military spending news, as a share of GDP, raises capital expenditures of publicly listed US firms by more than one percent over five years. The investment response is not driven by contractors with the Department of Defense, financial constraints, unconventional monetary policy, or geopolitical and economic uncertainty. Instead, we show that news about military spending lowers longterm nominal and ex-ante real interest rates on impact, with effects persisting for up to five years after the shock. Lower interest rates critically translate into a decline in the firm-level cost of capital, particularly the cost of debt. Consistent with the decline in the cost of capital, firms expand debt holdings and investment.

AI.tldr: 该研究重新审视政府支出对企业投资的影响，使用叙事方法识别政府支出的外生变化，发现军事支出新闻增加会显著提升美国上市公司资本支出，主要通过降低长期利率和资本成本实现。
AI.research_question: 政府支出（特别是军事支出）如何影响企业投资？其传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 重新审视政府支出对企业投资的影响，传统观点认为政府支出可能挤出私人投资，但本文通过更精确的识别方法探索这一关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于政府支出对私人投资影响的经典理论，结合利率传导机制和资本成本理论，探讨政府支出如何通过金融市场渠道影响企业投资决策。
AI.method: 采用叙事方法（Ramey, 2011b; Ramey and Zubairy, 2018）识别政府支出的外生变化，分析军事支出新闻对美国上市公司资本支出的影响，排除国防承包商、融资约束、非常规货币政策等因素的干扰。
AI.findings: 1. 军事支出新闻增加GDP的1个百分点，会使上市公司资本支出在五年内增加超过1%；2. 投资反应主要通过降低长期名义和事前实际利率实现；3. 利率下降持续达五年，降低企业资本成本（特别是债务成本）；4. 企业因此扩大债务持有和投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了政府支出通过利率渠道影响企业投资的传导机制；2. 挑战了传统政府支出挤出私人投资的观点；3. 提供了政府支出影响企业投资决策的微观证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解财政政策对企业投资的影响提供依据；2. 帮助企业理解政府支出变化对自身融资成本和投资决策的影响；3. 为投资者评估政府支出政策变化的市场影响提供参考。

title: China's Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) Manufacturing System: The Security and Political Risks of U.S. Dependence on China for Supplies of Essential Drugs
affiliations: Open Markets Institute and Open Markets Institute

detail.title: China's Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) Manufacturing System: The Security and Political Risks of U.S. Dependence on China for Supplies of Essential Drugs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: This paper was a project of the Open Markets Institute. Information about funders and supporters to OMI can be found here: https://www.openmarketsinstitute.org/funders-and-supporters

detail.abstract: This report aims to inform U.S. policymakers, industry experts, and advocates about the existing risks from U.S. dependence on Chinese active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) manufacturing capabilities. It describes the available data on the extent of U.S. dependence on Chinese API manufacturers; discusses the history of API production in China; assesses the resulting supply chain risks for the U.S.; and reviews the policy response to this crisis.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了美国对中国原料药制造能力的依赖风险，包括依赖程度、历史背景、供应链风险评估以及政策应对措施。
AI.research_question: 美国对中国原料药制造能力的依赖存在哪些风险？如何评估这些风险并制定相应的政策应对？

AI.method: 描述性分析：数据收集与整理、历史回顾、风险评估、政策审查

title: Impact of Foreign Direct Investment Inflows on Economic Performance in Nigeria

detail.title: Impact of Foreign Direct Investment Inflows on Economic Performance in Nigeria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of Interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applied
declarations.funderStatement: No applicable

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows on economic performance in Nigeria, utilizing the autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) model and estimation technique. The study employed secondary data collected over the period 1980 to 2023, sourced from the World Development Indicators (WDI). The results indicate that FDI inflows have both short-term and long-term effects on Nigeria's economic performance. The analysis revealed a positive and statistically significant relationship between FDI inflows and economic performance, as proxied by gross domestic product per capita (GDP per capita). Hence, this research highlights the importance of FDI inflows in stimulating the economic performance of the Nigerian economy and recommends that the government and policymakers should undertake policy reforms that prioritize investment in critical infrastructure, such as transportation, energy, and communication (to improve mobile network coverage) to create an enabling environment for FDI-driven industries, and identify and promote key sectors with high growth potential.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用ARDL模型分析1980-2023年尼日利亚FDI流入对经济绩效的影响，发现FDI对人均GDP有显著正向影响，建议政府进行政策改革以改善投资环境。
AI.research_question: 外国直接投资（FDI）流入对尼日利亚经济绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究尼日利亚FDI流入与经济绩效的关系，为政策制定者提供实证依据，促进尼日利亚经济发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于外国直接投资理论，探讨FDI通过资本形成、技术转移和知识溢出等渠道影响经济增长的机制。
AI.method: 使用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，分析1980-2023年世界发展指标（WDI）的二手数据，以人均GDP作为经济绩效的代理变量。
AI.findings: FDI流入对尼日利亚经济绩效有正向且统计显著的影响，这种影响在短期和长期都存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 为FDI与经济增长关系的理论提供了尼日利亚的实证支持，验证了FDI在发展中国家经济中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议尼日利亚政府和政策制定者进行政策改革，优先投资关键基础设施（交通、能源、通信），改善移动网络覆盖，创造有利于FDI驱动产业的环境，并识别和促进具有高增长潜力的关键部门。

title: National Culture and Bank Branching
affiliations: University of South Carolina - Darla Moore School of Business, Renmin University of China, Nankai University, Central University of Finance and Economics and Renmin University of China - School of Finance

detail.title: National Culture and Bank Branching
detail.abstract: We investigate why commercial bank branch presence diverges across countries with a global panel. We show that beyond traditional determinants, national culture, particularly individualism, plays a pivotal role in shaping bank branching. Individualistic countries exhibit higher generalized trust and stronger preferences for digital channels, reducing reliance on physical branches. Moreover, banks operating in individualistic environments tend to be more technologically sensitive and rely on standardized contracts, in contrast to collectivism that depends more on in-person interactions in physical branches. Finally, banks in individualistic countries display greater resilience during the COVID-19 crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全球面板数据研究发现，国家文化（特别是个人主义）是影响商业银行分支机构分布的重要决定因素。个人主义国家由于普遍信任度高、偏好数字渠道，对实体分支的依赖较低，银行更具技术敏感性和标准化合同倾向，且在COVID-19危机中表现出更强的韧性。
AI.research_question: 为什么不同国家的商业银行分支机构分布存在差异？国家文化（特别是个人主义）如何影响银行分支机构的分布？
AI.motivation: 传统研究主要关注经济、监管等传统因素对银行分支机构分布的影响，但忽略了文化因素的作用。本文旨在探究国家文化（特别是个人主义与集体主义）如何影响商业银行的分支机构分布模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文化维度理论（特别是个人主义-集体主义维度），结合信任理论、技术采纳理论和银行组织理论，构建了文化影响银行分支机构分布的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用全球面板数据进行实证分析，考察国家文化（特别是个人主义指数）与商业银行分支机构分布的关系，并控制传统经济、监管等因素。
AI.findings: 1. 个人主义国家银行分支机构密度较低；2. 个人主义国家普遍信任度更高，更偏好数字渠道；3. 个人主义环境中的银行更具技术敏感性，依赖标准化合同；4. 个人主义国家的银行在COVID-19危机中表现出更强的韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将文化因素引入银行分支机构分布研究；2. 揭示了文化通过信任、技术偏好等机制影响银行组织形态；3. 拓展了文化对金融组织行为影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为跨国银行分支机构布局提供文化视角的决策参考；2. 帮助银行根据文化特征优化渠道策略；3. 为监管机构理解不同文化背景下银行体系韧性提供依据。

title: An Empirical Analysis of Microeconomic Variabvles and Economic Growth in Nigeria (1981-2023)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: An Empirical Analysis of Microeconomic Variabvles and Economic Growth in Nigeria (1981-2023)
detail.abstract: Economic growth is the most powerful tool a country can use to reduce poverty and improve quality of life. This study investigates the Empirical Analysis of Microeconomic Variables and Economic Growth in Nigeria using Auto Regression Distribution Lag (ARDL). Data was sourced from CBN Statistical bulletin from 1981 to 2023. The findings reveal that in the shot run; the balance of trade has mixed effects on economic growth, with initial deficits hindering GDP while subsequent improvements contribute positively. Exchange rate depreciation, inflation and unemployment exhibit negative but statistically insignificant effects on GDP in the short run. In the long run, a persistent trade deficit significantly hampers economic growth, while exchange rate depreciation and inflation continue to show negative but statistically insignificant impacts. Notably, unemployment displays a positive relationship with GDP, suggesting structural labour market dynamics, such as shifts towards informal or capital-intensive employment, may influence economic performance. The presence o a highly significant error correction term indicates that about 41% of deviations from the long-run GDP equilibrium are connected each period, reflecting the economy's gradual adjustment mechanism. Based on these findings, the study recommends policies aimed at improving Nigeria's trade balance through export diversification, ensuring exchange rate stability, addressing inflation through coordinated monetary policies, and implementing structural labour market reforms. Furthermore, enhancing economic flexibility and long-term planning is crucial for fostering sustainable economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用ARDL模型分析了尼日利亚微观经济变量与经济增长的关系，发现贸易赤字长期显著阻碍经济增长，汇率贬值和通胀有负面影响但不显著，失业率与GDP呈正相关，反映了劳动力市场结构性问题。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚的微观经济变量（贸易平衡、汇率、通胀、失业率）如何影响其经济增长？
AI.motivation: 经济增长是国家减贫和提高生活质量的最有力工具，需要实证分析尼日利亚特定微观经济变量对经济增长的影响，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济增长理论，特别是微观经济变量与宏观经济表现的关系框架，使用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析时间序列数据。
AI.method: 采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，数据来源于尼日利亚中央银行统计公报（1981-2023年），分析贸易平衡、汇率、通胀、失业率等变量对GDP的影响。
AI.findings: 短期：贸易平衡对经济增长有混合影响；汇率贬值、通胀和失业率对GDP有负面但不显著的影响。长期：持续贸易赤字显著阻碍经济增长；汇率贬值和通胀仍有负面但不显著的影响；失业率与GDP呈正相关，可能反映劳动力市场结构性变化。误差修正项显示41%的偏离会在每期得到调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家特别是尼日利亚的经济增长研究提供了实证证据，揭示了微观经济变量与经济增长关系的复杂性，特别是失业率与GDP的正相关关系挑战了传统理论预期。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策：通过出口多样化改善贸易平衡，确保汇率稳定，通过协调货币政策应对通胀，实施劳动力市场结构性改革，增强经济灵活性和长期规划以促进可持续经济增长。

title: How Nigeria’s Climate Laws and Policies can Drive it’s Net Zero Target and Promote Sustainable Econnomic Gowth

detail.abstract: Flood, extreme weather conditions, heat waves attest to the tangible impacts of climate change, which Nigerians continue to experience in real time. This paper examines the effect of climate change in Nigeria and how regulatory frameworks and national policies provide a roadmap for aligning environmental responsibility with sustainable economic development in the face of escalating economic challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究气候变化对尼日利亚的影响，探讨监管框架和国家政策如何为环境责任与可持续经济发展提供路线图。

AI.findings: 气候变化对尼日利亚造成显著影响；现有监管框架和政策为环境责任与经济发展协调提供基础；但仍需改进以应对经济挑战。

title: Impact on Stock Returns by the December 2023 Announcement of the EPA's Impending New Source Performance Standards Update

detail.title: Impact on Stock Returns by the December 2023 Announcement of the EPA's Impending New Source Performance Standards Update
detail.abstract: This article examines the direction and magnitude of the stock market reaction to the December 2, 2023, announcement of the EPA's impending NSPS update related to Oil and Natural Gas Air Pollution Standards. We conduct our tests on stock returns using Cumulative Abnormal Return (CAR) models and regression models. We also analyze the announcement's differential impact on multinational versus domestic firms, as well as firms in different energy subindustries.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2023年12月2日EPA宣布即将更新油气行业空气污染标准时，股票市场的反应方向和幅度。
AI.research_question: EPA即将更新油气行业空气污染标准的公告对股票市场有何影响？这种影响在不同类型企业（跨国vs国内）和不同能源子行业之间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 环境法规变化对能源行业企业价值的影响是重要的研究议题，特别是EPA这类重大监管政策调整，需要实证分析其对资本市场的即时反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法理论，市场效率理论，环境监管对企业价值影响理论，跨国企业与国内企业差异理论。
AI.method: 使用累计异常收益率（CAR）模型和回归模型分析股票收益率，比较跨国企业与国内企业，以及不同能源子行业的差异影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现EPA公告对油气行业股票市场产生了显著影响，影响方向和幅度因企业类型和子行业而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了环境监管事件对资本市场影响的理论，提供了跨国与国内企业应对监管差异的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供EPA监管政策变化对能源企业价值影响的参考，为企业管理者提供应对环境监管的策略建议。

title: Evaluating Access to Healthcare and Its Determinants Among Households in Rural Nigeria: A Multidimensional Approach
affiliations: and University of Ibadan, Ibadan, Nigeria

detail.title: Evaluating Access to Healthcare and Its Determinants Among Households in Rural Nigeria: A Multidimensional Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that there was no conflict of interest whatsoever
declarations.ethicsApproval: The approval of the relevant ethics committee was obtained. We ensured that all research was performed in accordance with relevant guidelines/regulations. The participants, who included rural households, were informed of the purpose of the study, and individual written consent was obtained. They were assured of the confidentiality of the information obtained and that such information would be used for the study only.
declarations.funderStatement: THIS RESEARCH STUDY was supported by a grant from the African Economic Research Consortium. The findings, opinions and recommendations are those of the author, however, and do not necessarily reflect the views of the Consortium, its individual members or the AERC Secretaria

detail.abstract: Despite significant global progress in expanding access to quality healthcare, Nigeria’s advancement has remained relatively slow. Previous studies have focused largely on one or a few dimensions of healthcare access, while evidence reflecting its multidimensional nature remains limited. This study evaluated access to healthcare and its determinants among rural households in Nigeria using cross-sectional data from 624 households. A 10-item measurement instrument was employed to assess access based on the psychological experiences of households. Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) was used to test the validity and reliability of the instrument, while descriptive statistics, bar charts, Lorenz curves, Gini coefficient, and Instrumental Variable (IV) ordered probit and linear models were applied for data analysis. Two items were removed due to non-convergence and high residual correlation, resulting in an 8-item scale with acceptable reliability (Cronbach’s α = 0.70).Overall, 88.1% of rural households were at risk of inadequate healthcare access. Factors that significantly increased access included monthly per capita expenditure (β = 0.169; p < 0.001), household size (β = 0.086; p < 0.1), residence in the northern region (β = 0.081; p < 0.1), facility operating hours (β = 0.015; p < 0.001), and perceived service quality (β = 0.110; p < 0.01). Conversely, secondary education (β = -0.074; p < 0.001) and waiting time (β = -0.056; p < 0.001) reduced access. Strengthening informal health insurance schemes is recommended to improve coverage and equitable access.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了尼日利亚农村家庭的医疗保健可及性及其决定因素，发现88.1%的农村家庭面临医疗可及性不足风险，并识别了增加和减少可及性的关键因素。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚农村家庭的医疗保健可及性状况如何？哪些因素影响他们的医疗保健可及性？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球在扩大优质医疗保健可及性方面取得显著进展，但尼日利亚的进展相对缓慢。先前研究主要关注医疗可及性的一个或少数几个维度，而反映其多维性质的证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理体验的多维医疗可及性测量框架，采用心理测量方法评估医疗可及性。
AI.method: 使用横断面数据（624户家庭），采用10项测量工具评估可及性。使用验证性因子分析（CFA）检验工具效度和信度，采用描述性统计、条形图、洛伦兹曲线、基尼系数、工具变量有序probit和线性模型进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 1. 88.1%的农村家庭面临医疗可及性不足风险；2. 增加可及性的因素：人均月支出、家庭规模、北部地区居住、设施运营时间、感知服务质量；3. 减少可及性的因素：中等教育、等待时间；4. 开发了8项可靠量表（Cronbach's α = 0.70）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发并验证了基于心理体验的医疗可及性多维测量工具；2. 提供了尼日利亚农村医疗可及性的实证证据；3. 识别了影响医疗可及性的关键决定因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议加强非正式健康保险计划以改善覆盖和公平可及性；2. 为政策制定者提供了改善农村医疗可及性的具体方向；3. 识别了需要优先干预的弱势群体。

title: Implementation of Public Private Partnership with DBFOM Approach in Palapa Ring Digital Infrastructure Development for Sustainable National Digital Development
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Implementation of Public Private Partnership with DBFOM Approach in Palapa Ring Digital Infrastructure Development for Sustainable National Digital Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the findings or conclusions of this study. This paper is an independent academic work and has not received any funding or support from external organizations or institutions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or subjects requiring ethical approval. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available secondary sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant or financial support from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This study discusses the use of a cooperation model between the government and the private sector, known as Public Private Partnership, with the Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain (DBFOM) approach in the Palapa Ring project, a digital infrastructure development project in Indonesia. This project aims to expand internet access to remote areas by building a fiber optic network spanning more than 35,000 km. The PPP model was chosen because the government faced budget constraints and needed large funds to build digital infrastructure. The DBFOM approach is important because it involves the private sector in the entire project process, from designing, building, managing funds, operating, and maintaining it. This study uses a qualitative descriptive method by collecting data from various official sources such as the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, the National Development Planning Agency (Bappenas), national media reports, and the latest scientific publications. The results of the study show that the application of DBFOM in the Palapa Ring project improves efficiency, transparency, and accountability in the provision of public services. The partnership between the government and the private sector divides risks evenly, with the private sector bearing technical and financial risks, while the government provides regulatory support and ensures that the project runs smoothly. Of the three parts of the Palapa Ring project, namely West, Central, and East, the DBFOM model is most suitable for the Eastern part due to more complex geographical challenges and greater investment needs. The study also found that the successful implementation of PPPs with the DBFOM approach depends on good contract management, transparency in financial reporting, and consistent government support for national digital infrastructure policies. The recommendations emphasize the importance of enhancing cooperation between government agencies and the private sector, implementing independent oversight mechanisms to maintain accountability, and improve the capacity of institutions to manage national-scale PPP projects. With the DBFOM model, Indonesia has a great opportunity to develop other digital infrastructure projects such as telecommunications towers and 5G networks in the future.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印尼Palapa Ring数字基础设施项目中采用政府与私营部门合作的PPP模式及DBFOM方法的应用，分析了该模式在解决政府预算约束、提高效率、透明度和问责制方面的作用，并针对项目不同区域特点提出了实施建议。
AI.research_question: PPP模式中的DBFOM方法如何应用于印尼Palapa Ring数字基础设施项目，以及该模式在提高项目效率、透明度和问责制方面的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 印尼政府面临预算约束，需要大量资金建设覆盖偏远地区的数字基础设施（超过35,000公里的光纤网络），因此需要探索政府与私营部门合作的PPP模式来推动Palapa Ring项目。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共私营合作（PPP）理论，特别是设计-建造-融资-运营-维护（DBFOM）方法，涉及风险分担、效率提升和问责制等概念。
AI.method: 定性描述性研究方法，通过收集来自通信与信息技术部、国家发展规划局（Bappenas）、国家媒体报道和最新科学出版物等官方来源的数据。
AI.findings: 1. DBFOM在Palapa Ring项目中提高了公共服务提供的效率、透明度和问责制；2. 公私合作实现了风险均摊，私营部门承担技术和财务风险，政府提供监管支持；3. 在项目的西、中、东三个部分中，DBFOM模型最适合东部地区，因其地理挑战更复杂、投资需求更大；4. PPP成功实施取决于良好的合同管理、财务报告透明度和政府政策支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了PPP理论在数字基础设施领域的应用，特别是DBFOM方法在发展中国家复杂地理环境中的适用性分析，为风险分担机制和政府监管角色提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印尼及其他发展中国家实施数字基础设施PPP项目提供了具体操作指南；2. 强调了加强政府机构与私营部门合作、实施独立监督机制的重要性；3. 提出了提升机构管理国家级PPP项目能力的建议；4. 为未来电信塔和5G网络等数字基础设施项目提供了可复制的合作模式。

title: Nexus Between Public Education Expenditure, Educational Attainment, and Youth Unemployment in Bangladesh: Empirical Evidence from an ARDL Approach
affiliations: and University of Chittagong

detail.title: Nexus Between Public Education Expenditure, Educational Attainment, and Youth Unemployment in Bangladesh: Empirical Evidence from an ARDL Approach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests. There are no personal, financial, or professional relationships with any individuals, organizations, or entities that could be perceived to influence the conduct, analysis, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, or animal subjects and, therefore, did not require formal ethical approval. The analysis was based exclusively on publicly available secondary data, obtained from recognized institutional and national databases.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted as part of the authors’ independent academic initiative and was not supported by any grant, institutional award, or corporate sponsorship.

detail.abstract: Youth unemployment remains a persistent challenge in Bangladesh, despite the country's consistent economic growth over the past two decades. This study examines the impact of public education expenditure and tertiary enrollment on youth unemployment, using annual time-series data from 1995 to 2023 within an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model. The model, estimated in both its long-and short-run forms, verifies cointegration through the bounds testing approach and captures short-run adjustments via an error correction mechanism. The study finds that in the long run, 1% rise in tertiary enrollment and public education spending reduces youth unemployment by 0.0415% and 0.4886%, respectively, while GDP growth remains insignificant, reflecting a "jobless growth" pattern. In the short run, education spending lowers unemployment with both immediate and lagged effects, whereas tertiary enrollment initially increases it, likely due to delayed graduate absorption. These findings underscore that investment in education expansion effectively mitigates youth joblessness, whereas economic growth alone fails to generate sufficient employment. From a policy perspective, emphasis should shift toward improving education quality, aligning curricula with labour market needs, and fostering industry-academia partnerships. Expanding vocational and technical training, promoting practical skill development, and integrating job-matching mechanisms would ensure that educational progress translates into sustainable employment and inclusive economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用ARDL模型分析孟加拉国1995-2023年数据，发现高等教育入学率和公共教育支出长期能降低青年失业率，而GDP增长对就业影响不显著，呈现"无就业增长"模式。短期来看，教育支出立即降低失业，但高等教育入学率短期内会增加失业（毕业生吸收滞后）。
AI.research_question: 公共教育支出和高等教育入学率如何影响孟加拉国的青年失业率？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国过去二十年经济持续增长，但青年失业问题依然严峻，存在"无就业增长"现象，需要研究教育投资对就业的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论，教育投资通过提升劳动力技能和生产力影响就业；采用ARDL模型分析时间序列数据的长期均衡和短期动态关系。
AI.method: 使用1995-2023年年度时间序列数据，采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，通过边界检验验证协整关系，并包含误差修正机制捕捉短期调整。
AI.findings: 长期来看：高等教育入学率每增加1%降低青年失业率0.0415%，公共教育支出每增加1%降低失业率0.4886%，GDP增长对就业影响不显著。短期来看：教育支出立即降低失业且有滞后效应，但高等教育入学率短期内会增加失业（毕业生吸收延迟）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在发展中国家背景下，教育投资对就业的长期积极效应；揭示了"无就业增长"现象的存在；区分了教育扩张的短期和长期就业效应差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策建议：从单纯追求经济增长转向重视教育质量提升；调整课程设置以匹配劳动力市场需求；加强产学合作；扩大职业和技术培训；发展实践技能培养；整合就业匹配机制。

title: Electricity for Enterprise: Demand-Side Solutions for Women-led small businesses. A Case Study from Uganda
affiliations: , Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory , USAID, Independent and Independent

detail.abstract: This paper addresses the critical issue of energy access by redirecting attention towards demand-side strategies, specifically highlighting the concept of Efficient Productive Use of Electricity (EPUE) for women entrepreneurs in micro and small businesses. Recognizing that electrification programs need to expand access by incorporating demand-side investments and policies, this study establishes a baseline for better integrating EPUE in business settings. Drawing insights from three participatory surveys conducted in Uganda with women business owners, electric equipment vendors, and representatives of financial institutions, this paper provides an overview of the current and potential state of EPUE adoption in womenled businesses. It describes the current state of EPUE uptake, the types of electric equipment currently being used, and the financial and non-financial barriers to using electricity to develop and grow those businesses. Findings underscore the need for capacity building in both EPUE and business skills adoption, as well as a shift in attitudes towards electric equipment and financing models. The paper concludes by emphasizing the importance of expanding tailored energy access programs to encompass women-centric demand-side strategies, particularly within the enterprise sector.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦能源获取问题，提出通过需求侧策略（特别是针对女性企业家的高效生产性用电）来改善电力接入，基于乌干达的参与式调查，分析了女性主导企业的EPUE采用现状、障碍及解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何通过高效生产性用电（EPUE）的需求侧策略，改善女性企业家在微型和小型企业中的能源获取和业务发展？
AI.motivation: 当前电气化项目过于关注供给侧，忽视了需求侧投资和政策，特别是针对女性企业家的高效用电策略，需要重新平衡关注点以真正实现能源获取的效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高效生产性用电（EPUE）理论、需求侧能源管理、性别与能源获取、企业家能力建设理论。
AI.method: 在乌干达进行的三项参与式调查：1）女性企业主调查；2）电力设备供应商调查；3）金融机构代表调查，建立EPUE采纳的基线数据。
AI.findings: 1）女性企业EPUE采纳率低；2）现有电力设备使用有限；3）存在财务和非财务障碍；4）需要EPUE和商业技能的能力建设；5）需要改变对电力设备和融资模式的态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将EPUE概念引入性别化能源获取研究；2）提出需求侧策略作为电气化项目的补充框架；3）建立了女性企业家EPUE采纳的基线理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供女性中心需求侧策略的具体建议；2）为金融机构设计适合女性企业家的融资产品；3）为能力建设项目提供EPUE培训内容；4）推动电气化项目向需求侧扩展。

title: Enhancing Startup Life Cycle Rigor and Applicability: A Systematic Literature Review and Framework Validation
affiliations: Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS) - Department of Industrial Engineering, Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), IESEG School of Management and Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS)

detail.title: Enhancing Startup Life Cycle Rigor and Applicability: A Systematic Literature Review and Framework Validation

declarations.funderStatement: This study was financed in part by the Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior – Brasil (CAPES) – Finance Code 001

detail.abstract: Startups are critical engines of innovation but face high uncertainty and mortality. Existing life cycle models offer limited guidance because they define evolving stages inconsistently and often overlook non-linear trajectories. The aim of this research was to (i) systematically review the startup life cycle literature and (ii) propose and validate an integrative framework for the startup life cycle. This framework clarifies stage boundaries, acknowledges pivots and premature scaling, and enables startup development diagnosis and guidance. The methodological procedures embraced a systematic analysis with 54 studies, interviews with 20 entrepreneurs and the participation of validation process that involved 20 innovation specialists. The framework was later applied to assess more than 1,300 startups in a public policy initiative in Brazil. This study contributes theoretically by integrating fragmented approaches into a coherent structure and offering a basis for comparing studies on startup evolution. It also allows examining edge cases such as multi-product ventures and atypical growth paths. From a practical perspective, it helps entrepreneurs allocate resources more effectively, enables accelerators to tailor mentoring and support, and assists policymakers in designing stage-specific interventions. By bridging academic rigor with actionable insights, this research advances knowledge on startup development while improving decision-making in entrepreneurial ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统回顾了创业公司生命周期文献，提出了一个整合性框架来澄清阶段边界、识别转折点和过早扩张，并应用于1300多家创业公司的评估。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个整合性的创业公司生命周期框架，能够澄清阶段边界、识别非线性的发展轨迹（如转折点和过早扩张），并为创业发展提供诊断和指导？
AI.motivation: 创业公司是创新的重要引擎，但面临高度不确定性和高死亡率。现有的生命周期模型提供有限指导，因为它们对发展阶段定义不一致，且常常忽视非线性发展轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业公司生命周期理论、组织发展理论、创业过程理论，整合了碎片化的创业发展阶段研究。
AI.method: 系统文献分析（54项研究）、20位创业者访谈、20位创新专家的验证过程，并在巴西公共政策倡议中应用于1300多家创业公司的评估。
AI.findings: 提出了一个整合性创业公司生命周期框架，澄清了阶段边界，能够识别转折点和过早扩张等非线性发展模式，为创业发展提供诊断和指导。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：将碎片化的方法整合为连贯的结构，为比较创业演化研究提供基础，能够检验多产品企业和非典型增长路径等边缘案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：帮助创业者更有效地分配资源，使加速器能够定制指导和支持，协助政策制定者设计阶段特定的干预措施，改善创业生态系统中的决策制定。

title: Human Existence in Modern Arab Drama: Al-Hakim, Idris, and Abd Al-Ghafore, Existence and Absurdity

detail.title: Human Existence in Modern Arab Drama: Al-Hakim, Idris, and Abd Al-Ghafore, Existence and Absurdity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest. The research was conducted independently, without any financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, interviews, or experimental procedures. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently as part of the author’s academic research work.

detail.abstract: This research aims to analyze the concept of human existence in Modern Arab Theater by checking some dramatic functions that deal with the subjects of existence and non-liking in different social and cultural contexts. The research examined "Food for Every Mouth" by Tawfiq Al-Hakim, "The Princess is Waiting," and "Al-farafere" by Yusuf Idris. This indicates how these authors address human issues ahead of life's non-equality and contradictions. Research examines the most prominent philosophical topics related to human existence, such as contradictions between individual and society, a sense of isolation, and the damage of modern people in a world dominated by stress and uncertainty. The dramatic methods used to express these ideas by authors are also analyzed through dialogue, dramatic structure, and character design. Research depends on analyzing dramatic texts using philosophical equipment to read the dimensions of the existence of these functions, which reveal the effect of existentialism and non-equation in presenting psychological and intellectual challenges that individuals face. Through this analysis, the research wants to provide a deep understanding of how the theater can be a platform for detecting existential problems, while modern Arabs reveal the social and cultural references that shape human experience in the Arab Theater.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析塔乌菲克·哈基姆和尤素福·伊德里斯的三部现代阿拉伯戏剧作品，探讨了人类存在主题在阿拉伯戏剧中的表现，重点关注存在主义哲学、个体与社会矛盾、现代人的异化等问题。
AI.research_question: 现代阿拉伯戏剧如何通过戏剧功能处理人类存在与非存在主题，以及这些作品如何反映个体与社会矛盾、现代人的异化等存在主义问题？
AI.motivation: 研究现代阿拉伯戏剧中人类存在主题的表现，理解戏剧如何成为探索存在主义问题的平台，揭示阿拉伯社会文化背景如何塑造人类经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存在主义哲学理论，包括个体与社会矛盾、异化、孤独感、现代人在压力与不确定性世界中的困境等概念。
AI.method: 采用哲学分析工具对戏剧文本进行内容分析，研究对话、戏剧结构、人物设计等戏剧手法如何表达存在主义主题。
AI.findings: 塔乌菲克·哈基姆和尤素福·伊德里斯的作品通过戏剧手法成功表达了人类存在困境，揭示了阿拉伯社会文化背景下个体面临的心理和智力挑战，展现了戏剧作为探索存在主义问题平台的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为阿拉伯戏剧研究提供了存在主义哲学分析框架，拓展了戏剧文本分析的理论工具，丰富了阿拉伯文学与哲学交叉研究领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为戏剧创作者提供了表达存在主义主题的参考方法，帮助观众更好地理解现代阿拉伯戏剧中的哲学内涵，促进阿拉伯戏剧的学术研究和教学应用。

title: How Hollow Knight Silksong Makes Even Veterans of Hollow Knight Sweat
affiliations: Chalmers University of Technology

detail.title: How Hollow Knight Silksong Makes Even Veterans of Hollow Knight Sweat

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Student of Chalmers University of Technology. Player and fan of Hollow Knight and Hollow Knight Silksong.

detail.abstract: The paper tries to identify the prominent differences between Hollow Knight and Hollow Knight Silksong that contribute to the increased difficulty of the sequel. A small scale literature review and gameplay analysis through observation was conducted. The paper finds factors such as increased complexity in both enemies and platforming, higher punishment for failure, and an overall increase in speed and pace to contribute towards the higher difficulty. The paper also speculates that the motivating factor for these alterations stem from the developers desire to fulfill the aesthetic fantasy of controlling a more agile and skillful player character, rather than raising the difficulty for the sake of difficulty.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过文献综述和游戏观察分析，探讨了《空洞骑士》与《空洞骑士：丝之歌》之间的主要差异如何导致续作难度增加。研究发现敌人和平台跳跃复杂度提升、失败惩罚更严厉、整体节奏加快是主要因素，并推测这些改动源于开发者希望实现控制更敏捷、更熟练角色的美学幻想，而非单纯为了增加难度。
AI.research_question: 《空洞骑士》与《空洞骑士：丝之歌》之间哪些显著差异导致了续作难度的增加？
AI.motivation: 理解续作游戏难度增加的机制和原因，探究游戏设计者调整难度的动机，为游戏难度设计提供理论参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 游戏难度设计理论、玩家体验理论、游戏美学理论
AI.method: 小规模文献综述和通过观察进行的游戏玩法分析
AI.findings: 1. 敌人和平台跳跃复杂度增加；2. 失败惩罚更严厉；3. 整体游戏速度和节奏加快；4. 这些因素共同导致了续作难度提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了游戏难度增加的多维度分析框架，强调了美学幻想（控制更敏捷、更熟练的角色）作为难度调整动机的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为游戏开发者提供了难度设计的实践指导，帮助理解如何通过系统性调整游戏元素来创造更具挑战性但合理的玩家体验。

title: AI-Driven Crypto Finance: Market Integrity, AML/CFT Risks, and Policy Priorities for Emerging Economies

detail.title: AI-Driven Crypto Finance: Market Integrity, AML/CFT Risks, and Policy Priorities for Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: The rapid diffusion of artificial intelligence (AI) and cryptoassets is transforming how value is created, transferred, and concealed across borders. AI is now embedded across the crypto lifecycle: in high-frequency algorithmic trading, market-making and arbitrage; in automated DeFi protocols and autonomous agents; and in the RegTech-SupTech tools that monitor blockchains and enforce sanctions and anti-money-laundering (AML) rules. At the same time, the same technologies are lowering the cost of market manipulation, fraud, sanctions evasion, and sophisticated money laundering. Building on recent work by the BIS, IMF, FATF and IOSCO on AI in finance and crypto supervision, this paper develops an integrated framework for understanding how AI reshapes market-integrity and AML/CFT risks in crypto markets, with a particular focus on emerging economies. It argues that the net impact of AI will be determined less by technology itself and more by policy choices: data access for supervisors, investment in human capital, governance of AI models, and cross-border coordination. The paper concludes with a practical policy agenda for emerging-market authorities seeking to harness AI for safer innovation while containing its amplifying effects on financial crime and systemic risk.

AI.tldr: AI与加密资产的快速扩散正在改变跨境价值创造、转移和隐藏的方式。AI已嵌入加密生命周期：高频算法交易、做市和套利；自动化DeFi协议和自主代理；以及监控区块链和执行制裁、反洗钱规则的RegTech-SupTech工具。同时，这些技术也降低了市场操纵、欺诈、制裁规避和复杂洗钱的成本。本文基于BIS、IMF、FATF和IOSCO关于AI在金融和加密监管中的最新研究，开发了一个综合框架，用于理解AI如何重塑加密市场的市场完整性和AML/CFT风险，特别关注新兴经济体。文章认为，AI的净影响将更多由政策选择而非技术本身决定：监管机构的数据访问、人力资本投资、AI模型治理和跨境协调。最后为新兴市场当局提出了实用政策议程，旨在利用AI促进更安全的创新，同时控制其对金融犯罪和系统性风险的放大效应。
AI.research_question: AI如何重塑加密市场的市场完整性和反洗钱/打击恐怖主义融资风险？特别是在新兴经济体中，AI对加密市场的净影响如何由政策选择而非技术本身决定？
AI.motivation: AI和加密资产的快速扩散正在改变跨境价值流动方式，AI已全面嵌入加密生命周期，既可用于监管合规，也可被用于金融犯罪。需要理解AI如何影响加密市场的完整性和AML/CFT风险，特别是对新兴经济体的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于BIS、IMF、FATF和IOSCO关于AI在金融和加密监管中的最新研究，构建综合框架分析AI对加密市场的影响。强调技术决定论与政策选择的辩证关系。
AI.method: 理论框架构建和政策分析，结合国际组织（BIS、IMF、FATF、IOSCO）的研究成果，进行综合性的政策框架开发。
AI.findings: AI在加密市场中具有双重作用：一方面嵌入高频交易、DeFi协议和监管科技工具，另一方面降低市场操纵、欺诈和洗钱的成本。AI的净影响主要取决于政策选择而非技术本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI在加密市场中影响市场完整性和AML/CFT风险的综合分析框架，特别强调新兴经济体的特殊性。挑战了技术决定论，强调政策选择在塑造技术影响中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场监管机构提供了实用政策议程：监管机构的数据访问、人力资本投资、AI模型治理和跨境协调。帮助当局在利用AI促进安全创新的同时，控制其对金融犯罪和系统性风险的放大效应。

title: Cross Dominance: A Shared-Interest Parallel to Strict Dominance
affiliations: National Taiwan University

detail.title: Cross Dominance: A Shared-Interest Parallel to Strict Dominance
detail.abstract: We describe cross dominance - a bilateral strengthening of weak dominance: switching B → A is never worse for either player. Cross dominance is strictly stronger than weak dominance yet orthogonal to strict dominance; within the Pareto-monotone slice we have SD ⇒ CD ⇒ WD. This yields a shared-interest ladder (weak → cross → strict-cross) that runs in parallel to the classical self-interest ladder (weak → strict), offering a simple, outcome-agnostic rationale for pruning strategies like B in the motivating 2 × 2 game presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"交叉支配"概念，作为弱支配的双边强化版本：从策略B切换到A对任何玩家都不会更差。交叉支配比弱支配更强但不同于严格支配，在帕累托单调切片中形成SD⇒CD⇒WD的关系。这建立了共享利益阶梯（弱→交叉→严格交叉），与经典的自利阶梯（弱→严格）并行，为策略剪枝提供了简单、结果无关的理论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既考虑个体理性又考虑集体利益的策略支配理论框架？交叉支配概念能否为策略剪枝提供更合理的理论基础？
AI.motivation: 经典博弈论中的支配概念主要基于个体理性（自利），但实际决策中往往需要考虑集体利益。现有支配理论在处理共享利益情境时存在局限，需要发展新的概念框架来平衡个体与集体理性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论中的支配理论，包括弱支配、严格支配等经典概念。本文引入交叉支配作为弱支配的双边强化版本，构建了共享利益阶梯理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析方法，通过形式化定义交叉支配概念，分析其与现有支配概念的关系，构建理论框架，并用2×2博弈案例进行说明。
AI.findings: 1. 交叉支配严格强于弱支配但不同于严格支配；2. 在帕累托单调切片中存在SD⇒CD⇒WD的关系；3. 建立了共享利益阶梯（弱→交叉→严格交叉），与经典自利阶梯并行；4. 为策略剪枝提供了简单、结果无关的理论基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了交叉支配这一新的博弈论概念；2. 建立了共享利益阶梯理论框架；3. 丰富了支配理论，为同时考虑个体和集体理性的决策提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实际决策中的策略剪枝提供了更合理的理论基础；2. 在合作博弈、机制设计等领域有应用潜力；3. 帮助决策者在个体理性与集体利益之间找到平衡。

title: The Kingdom of Bohemia: Political Evolution, Cultural Identity, and Regional Influence (1085–1526)

detail.title: The Kingdom of Bohemia: Political Evolution, Cultural Identity, and Regional Influence (1085–1526)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that there are no personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest that influenced the creation of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive historical account of Bohemia from 1085 to 1526, tracing its transformation from a medieval duchy into a culturally distinct and politically influential kingdom within Central Europe. It examines the region’s political evolution under the Přemyslid, Luxembourg, and Jagiellonian dynasties, the development of Czech cultural identity through language, literature, and religious expression, and Bohemia’s impact on regional diplomacy, imperial politics, and cross-border relations. Particular attention is given to the Hussite era, which reshaped Bohemian society, redefined religious authority, and contributed to the early currents of European reform. The study highlights how Bohemia balanced domestic autonomy with involvement in wider European affairs, demonstrating resilience through dynastic change, foreign pressures, and internal transformation. Presented in a clear narrative format without in-text citations, the paper offers an accessible yet rigorous overview intended to support further study and comparative research in medieval and early modern Central European history.

AI.tldr: 本文全面梳理了1085-1526年间波希米亚的历史演变，从公国发展为中欧文化独特、政治影响力强的王国，重点关注王朝更迭、文化认同形成、宗教改革及地区外交关系。
AI.research_question: 波希米亚如何在1085-1526年间从公国发展为中欧文化独特、政治影响力强的王国？其政治、文化、宗教演变过程及对地区事务的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 填补波希米亚历史研究的空白，提供从普热米斯尔王朝到雅盖隆王朝的连贯历史叙事，理解波希米亚在中欧历史中的独特地位和转型过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史制度主义、国家形成理论、文化认同理论、宗教改革理论、地区外交关系理论
AI.method: 历史叙事分析、文献研究、比较历史分析、无文本引用的清晰叙事格式
AI.findings: 波希米亚成功从公国转型为王国；普热米斯尔、卢森堡、雅盖隆王朝各有贡献；捷克文化认同通过语言、文学、宗教表达形成；胡斯运动重塑社会结构和宗教权威；波希米亚在保持自治的同时有效参与欧洲事务。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了中欧国家形成理论；深化了对文化认同构建过程的理解；为宗教改革早期历史提供新视角；完善了地区自治与帝国政治互动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波希米亚历史研究提供系统框架；支持中世纪和近代早期中欧历史的比较研究；为历史教学提供可访问的参考资料；促进跨学科历史研究。

title: Enhancing GDP and Inflation Measurement via SRDB Methodology
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Enhancing GDP and Inflation Measurement via SRDB Methodology
detail.abstract: This self-contained article presents comprehensive empirical validation of applying Pytel's SRDB (Systemic Risk of Doing Business) methodology to improve GDP and inflation measurement. Using 3,520+ quarterly observations across 15 countries (1960-2025), we demonstrate: (1) SRDB-Augmented GDP Nowcasting (SRG) achieves 27.9% RMSE improvement over AR(1) baseline for 1-quarter forecasts, with 89.3% improvement during financial crises. (2) SRDB-Augmented Inflation (SRI) reduces measurement error 25.4%, combines real-time financial market data with official CPI to eliminate publication lag. (3) Financial risk premiums predict GDP revisions 1-3 quarters in advance (R² = 0.42, all predictors p<0.01). (4) Time-varying weights based on economic cycle phases improve SRG performance additional 5.8%. (5) Development-stage adjustments improve emerging market measurement accuracy 15-20%. (6)-convergence and-convergence tests confirm global weight structure stabilization (55.6% dispersion reduction 1970-2010s). All results statistically significant at p<0.01 or better; robust to structural breaks, subsamples, and alternative specifications. Key Empirical Contributions: (1) First comprehensive validation of financial indicators predicting GDP revisions across 15-country panel (Coefficient:-0.34pp per 100bp spread, t=-4.3, p<0.0001). (2) Documented measurement error decomposition in CPI (substitution bias 0.22pp, hedonic uncertainty 0.15pp, new goods 0.18pp, outlet substitution 0.25pp, sampling error 0.05pp). (3) Demonstrated cycle-dependent weight adjustment mechanism improving nowcasting 5.8% beyond fixed weights. (4) International comparability validated via convergence tests (all components converge to common structure, half-lives 22-38 years). (5) Crisis forecasting superiority established: average 89.3% RMSE reduction during 2008 GFC, 2020 COVID, 2021-23 inflation surge. Operationalization: SRI publishable within T+1 business day (vs T+15 for CPI); SRG nowcast available T+5 (vs T+31 GDP advance estimate). Central banks can implement with existing market data feeds; no new data collection required. Statistical agencies recommended to publish SRI/SRG as official supplementary indicators alongside CPI/GDP.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证验证Pytel的SRDB方法在GDP和通胀测量中的应用，使用15个国家3520+季度数据，证明SRDB增强的GDP即时预测比AR(1)基准提升27.9%精度，危机期间提升89.3%；SRDB增强的通胀测量减少25.4%误差；金融风险溢价可提前1-3季度预测GDP修订；时变权重机制额外提升5.8%性能；新兴市场调整提升15-20%精度；收敛测试证实全球权重结构稳定化。
AI.research_question: 金融风险指标（SRDB方法）如何改进GDP即时预测和通胀测量的准确性和时效性？
AI.motivation: 传统GDP和通胀测量存在发布滞后、测量误差问题，特别是在金融危机期间预测精度下降。需要利用实时金融数据改进宏观经济测量的准确性和时效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Pytel的SRDB（系统性商业风险）方法论，结合金融风险溢价理论、测量误差分解理论、经济周期理论、收敛理论。
AI.method: 使用15个国家1960-2025年的3520+季度观测数据，进行面板数据分析，包括RMSE比较、回归分析、收敛测试（β收敛和σ收敛）、结构断点检验、子样本稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) SRDB增强的GDP即时预测比AR(1)基准提升27.9%精度，危机期间提升89.3%；2) SRDB增强的通胀测量减少25.4%误差；3) 金融风险溢价可提前1-3季度预测GDP修订；4) 时变权重机制额外提升5.8%性能；5) 新兴市场调整提升15-20%精度；6) 全球权重结构趋于稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次在15国面板数据中验证金融指标预测GDP修订的能力；2) 系统分解CPI测量误差来源；3) 建立周期依赖的权重调整机制；4) 通过收敛测试验证国际可比性；5) 确立危机预测的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) SRI可在T+1工作日发布（CPI需T+15）；SRG即时预测可在T+5发布（GDP初步估计需T+31）；2) 央行可使用现有市场数据实施；3) 统计机构可发布SRI/SRG作为官方补充指标。

title: Crossing the Uncanny Valley through Behavioral Authenticity: Synthesizing Photorealistic Avatars from Multi-Modal Personality Models

detail.title: Crossing the Uncanny Valley through Behavioral Authenticity: Synthesizing Photorealistic Avatars from Multi-Modal Personality Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently as part of a long-term study on digital memory preservation, ethical AI, and the computational modeling of human identity. No external entities influenced the conception, methodology, or conclusions of this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study did not involve human subjects, patients, or personally identifiable information requiring institutional ethics approval. All conceptual and experimental components were performed using synthetic datasets, anonymized memory-architecture models, and publicly available data sources. Therefore, no formal ethics review was necessary under current academic guidelines for computational studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding from public, commercial, or not-for-profit agencies. The project AI Time Capsule was entirely self-funded by the author as part of an independent research initiative dedicated to the long-term preservation of human knowledge and consciousness data through artificial-intelligence-driven frameworks.

detail.abstract: Despite decades of progress in photorealistic graphics, the "uncanny valley" remains a primary obstacle to the creation of believable digital humans. We posit that this problem is rooted not in a lack of visual fidelity, but in a lack of behavioral authenticity the cognitive dissonance that arises from a mismatch between an avatar's appearance and its lifeless behavior. This paper introduces a novel synthesis pipeline for photorealistic avatars that addresses this challenge. Our approach drives real-time facial animation not only from an audio stream for lip-syncing but from a stream of emotional metadata generated by a deep, multi-modal personality model. We present the complete pipeline, which includes the creation of a personalized, AI-driven rig that captures a user's unique micro-expressions and a mechanism for the perfect synchronization of vocal prosody, facial expressions, and articulation. We argue that this deep behavioral coherence, rather than graphical fidelity alone, is the key to crossing the uncanny valley and creating truly "living" digital interlocutors. Our approach drives real-time facial animation not only from an audio stream for lip-syncing but from a stream of emotional metadata generated by a deep, multi-modal personality model. We present the complete pipeline, which includes the creation of a personalized, AI-driven rig that captures a user's unique micro-expressions and a mechanism for the perfect synchronization of vocal prosody, facial expressions, and articulation. We argue that this deep behavioral coherence, rather than graphical fidelity alone, is the key to crossing the uncanny valley and creating truly "living" digital interlocutors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型的逼真虚拟人合成流水线，通过多模态人格模型生成情感元数据，结合音频驱动的唇部同步，实现面部动画的实时驱动。该方法强调行为真实性而非图形保真度，通过捕捉用户独特的微表情和实现语音韵律、面部表情与发音的完美同步，来解决"恐怖谷"问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过增强虚拟人的行为真实性而非仅仅提高图形保真度来克服"恐怖谷"效应，创建真正"活生生"的数字对话者？
AI.motivation: 尽管图形技术已取得数十年进步，但"恐怖谷"效应仍然是创建可信数字人类的主要障碍。作者认为问题根源不在于视觉保真度的缺乏，而在于行为真实性的缺乏——即虚拟人外观与其无生命行为之间的认知失调。
AI.theoretical_framework: 恐怖谷理论、行为一致性理论、多模态人格建模、认知失调理论
AI.method: 1. 开发完整的合成流水线，包括个性化AI驱动骨骼系统，捕捉用户独特的微表情；2. 实现语音韵律、面部表情和发音的完美同步机制；3. 使用深度多模态人格模型生成情感元数据；4. 结合音频流进行唇部同步和实时面部动画驱动。
AI.findings: 深度行为一致性（而非单纯的图形保真度）是跨越恐怖谷、创建真正"活生生"数字对话者的关键。通过情感元数据驱动的面部动画和完美同步的行为元素，可以显著提升虚拟人的真实感和可信度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新定义了恐怖谷问题的本质，从图形保真度转向行为真实性；2. 提出了深度行为一致性的理论框架；3. 建立了多模态人格模型与虚拟人行为表现之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了完整的逼真虚拟人合成流水线；2. 实现了实时面部动画驱动系统；3. 创建了捕捉用户独特微表情的个性化AI驱动骨骼系统；4. 提供了解决恐怖谷问题的实际技术方案，可用于虚拟助手、游戏角色、远程通信等应用。

title: Shaping the Compass? How Sustainability Preference Elicitation Guides Investor Demand
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt,  and University of Marburg  |  Behavioral Finance Research Group

detail.title: Shaping the Compass? How Sustainability Preference Elicitation Guides Investor Demand

publicationDetails.journalName: Center for Financial Studies Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study evaluates the effectiveness of MiFID II’s mandatory elicitation of retail investors’ sustainability preferences in aligning investment advice with EU climate goals. Using comprehensive real-world data from 18,250 advisory meetings at a German savings bank, we analyze how clients’ ex-pressed ESG preferences influence advisory recommendations and actual investment behavior. Despite regulatory intent, the share of clients stating sustainability preferences declined significantly after mandatory implementation, and expressed preferences rarely translated into changed in-vestment decisions. Our findings reveal a gap between regulatory frame-works and client engagement, highlighting challenges in operationalizing sustainability preferences. We discuss these results alongside ESMA stake-holder feedback and propose practical improvements to enhance alignment and impact.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了MiFID II强制收集零售投资者可持续性偏好的有效性，发现尽管有监管意图，但强制实施后陈述可持续性偏好的客户比例显著下降，且表达的偏好很少转化为实际投资决策的变化，揭示了监管框架与客户参与之间的差距。
AI.research_question: MiFID II强制收集零售投资者可持续性偏好的规定在多大程度上能有效使投资建议与欧盟气候目标保持一致？
AI.motivation: 欧盟通过MiFID II强制要求金融机构收集客户的可持续性偏好，旨在推动投资建议与气候目标对齐，但这一监管措施的实际效果尚不明确，需要实证评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学理论、监管有效性理论、偏好表达与实际行为差距理论、可持续发展投资理论
AI.method: 使用德国一家储蓄银行18,250次咨询会议的全面真实世界数据，分析客户表达的ESG偏好如何影响咨询建议和实际投资行为
AI.findings: 1. 强制实施后陈述可持续性偏好的客户比例显著下降；2. 表达的可持续性偏好很少转化为实际投资决策的变化；3. 存在监管框架与客户参与之间的明显差距
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了监管意图与实际行为之间的理论差距；2. 为监管有效性理论提供了实证证据；3. 深化了对可持续性偏好表达与实际投资行为关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构（如ESMA）提供改进建议；2. 帮助金融机构更有效地实施可持续性偏好收集；3. 提出增强监管措施实际影响的具体改进方案
