reference: Fisher College of Business Working Paper Forthcoming
title: Strategic Benefits of Information Leakage in Supply Chains
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Fisher College of Business and Indian School of Business

detail.title: Strategic Benefits of Information Leakage in Supply Chains

publicationDetails.detailsText: Fisher College of Business Working Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Ohio State University, Fisher College of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The conventional view is that information leakage puts a firm at a disadvantage by limiting its ability to manage its information environment. In contrast, this study demonstrates that the possibility of leakage can sometimes enhance firm value. When an informed firm has the option to disclose, other supply chain participants fear adverse selection, attributing silence by the firm as indicative of the firm concealing news advantageous to them. This distrust can lead participants to take actions that are detrimental to the firm. The possibility of information leakage, then, benefits the firm by allaying these adverse selection concerns and fostering decisions among supply chain participants that are more favorable for the firm. Specifically, this study examines how voluntary disclosures and unintentional leakage combine to create an information environment that enables a firm to optimally curtail a potential rival's entry and manage a supplier's pricing terms.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了传统观点，证明信息泄露有时能提升企业价值。当知情企业有披露选择时，供应链参与者会担心逆向选择，将企业的沉默视为隐瞒有利信息。信息泄露的可能性通过缓解这种担忧，促使参与者做出对企业更有利的决策。
AI.research_question: 信息泄露如何影响企业价值？具体而言，自愿披露和无意识泄露如何共同创造信息环境，帮助企业优化管理潜在竞争对手进入和供应商定价条款？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为信息泄露对企业不利，限制了其管理信息环境的能力。本研究挑战这一观点，探索信息泄露可能带来的积极效应，特别是在供应链关系中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息经济学和逆向选择理论，结合供应链管理中的信息不对称问题，分析自愿披露与无意识泄露的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，通过构建博弈论框架考察信息环境对企业战略决策的影响。
AI.findings: 信息泄露的可能性可以提升企业价值：1）缓解供应链参与者的逆向选择担忧；2）促使参与者做出对企业更有利的决策；3）帮助企业优化管理竞争对手进入和供应商定价。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统信息泄露负面效应的观点，提出了信息泄露可能具有积极价值的理论框架，扩展了信息经济学在供应链管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业信息管理策略提供新视角：有时允许或容忍一定程度的泄露可能比完全保密更有利；帮助企业优化供应链关系管理。

title: Sectoral Divergence after a Shock: Wage Inequality and the Real Effects of Uzbekistan's 2017 Currency Liberalization

detail.title: Sectoral Divergence after a Shock: Wage Inequality and the Real Effects of Uzbekistan's 2017 Currency Liberalization
detail.abstract: This paper provides a causal estimate of the economic effects of Uzbekistan's September 2017 currency liberalization, a landmark reform that devalued the official exchange rate by nearly 50% and ended a long-standing dual-rate regime. Using an industrylevel panel dataset from 2010 to 2024, we employ a Difference-inDifferences (DiD) and event study methodology to analyze the reform's impact on real wages. We define "treated" industries as those with high exposure to international trade and capital mobility (Information & Communication, Finance, Industry) and "control" industries as those primarily oriented toward the domestic, non-tradable sector (Education, Health, Accommodation). Our results reveal a substantial and statistically significant divergence: real wages in the treated group grew approximately 30.8% faster relative to the control group. Crucially, we find no corresponding divergence in employment levels, suggesting the adjustment occurred primarily through prices rather than quantities. Our findings are robust to a series of specification checks and are validated by a placebo test. This study highlights the powerful, heterogeneous consequences of macroeconomic stabilization policies and underscores the critical role of sectoral characteristics in mediating the real effects of exchange rate shocks. These findings suggest that policymakers should consider sectoral disparities when implementing currency reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过双重差分法和事件研究法，评估了乌兹别克斯坦2017年9月货币自由化改革对实际工资的影响。研究发现，高贸易开放度行业（信息通信、金融、工业）的实际工资增长比低开放度行业（教育、医疗、住宿）快约30.8%，但就业水平未出现相应分化，表明调整主要通过价格而非数量渠道实现。
AI.research_question: 乌兹别克斯坦2017年货币自由化改革（汇率贬值50%并结束双轨制）对不同行业实际工资产生了怎样的因果效应？
AI.motivation: 货币自由化是重要的宏观经济稳定政策，但其对不同行业的异质性影响尚未得到充分研究。乌兹别克斯坦2017年的改革提供了一个自然实验机会，可以评估汇率冲击如何通过行业特征传导到劳动力市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际贸易理论（特别是关于贸易开放度与工资关系的理论）、汇率传导理论、以及双重差分法在政策评估中的应用框架。
AI.method: 使用2010-2024年行业层面面板数据，采用双重差分法和事件研究法。将高国际贸易和资本流动暴露的行业（信息通信、金融、工业）定义为处理组，主要面向国内非贸易部门的行业（教育、医疗、住宿）定义为对照组。
AI.findings: 处理组行业的实际工资相对于对照组增长了约30.8%，且统计显著。但就业水平未出现相应分化，表明调整主要通过价格渠道而非数量渠道实现。结果经过一系列稳健性检验和安慰剂检验验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了宏观经济稳定政策的异质性后果，强调了行业特征在调节汇率冲击实际效应中的关键作用，为理解汇率传导机制提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者在实施货币改革时应考虑行业差异，避免加剧不平等。研究结果为评估类似改革的影响提供了方法论参考，有助于设计更具包容性的政策。

reference: The ANNALS of the American Academy of Political and Social Science, volume 715, issue 1, 2024[10.1177/00027162251382253]; Fordham Law Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
title: Middleware and the Illusory Promise of End-User Control
affiliations: Fordham University School of Law

detail.title: Middleware and the Illusory Promise of End-User Control

publicationDetails.detailsText: The ANNALS of the American Academy of Political and Social Science, volume 715, issue 1, 2024[10.1177/00027162251382253]
Fordham Law Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Fordham Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Concerned about the power that social media now wield, a chorus of tech-minded reformers have called for a return to the internet’s foundational design principles of interoperability and end-user control. This group argues for “middleware”—online tools like browser extensions and consumer-facing protocols that would enable people to take control of their online experiences across the web. This article argues that the campaign for middleware is laudable but mostly speculative and inapposite. It proceeds on the disproven theory that consumers can control their online experiences in today’s networked information economy. As such, it distracts reformers from solutions that would redress the structural asymmetries that define today’s market for consumer-facing services, including social media. This article argues that it is time to give up the illusory promise of user control and attend above all to enacting enforceable restrictions on service designs and commercial surveillance practices.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了"中间件"解决方案，认为其基于错误假设——消费者能在网络信息经济中控制自己的在线体验。文章主张放弃用户控制的虚幻承诺，转而关注对服务设计和商业监控实践的可执行限制。
AI.research_question: 中间件解决方案是否能够有效解决社交媒体权力集中问题？消费者是否真的能够在当今网络信息经济中控制自己的在线体验？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体平台权力过大，技术改革者呼吁回归互联网互操作性和终端用户控制的基本原则，提出"中间件"解决方案。但作者认为这一方案存在根本缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络信息经济理论、消费者控制理论、结构不对称理论、监管与设计限制理论
AI.method: 理论分析与批判性论证，基于现有技术改革主张的评估
AI.findings: 中间件运动虽然值得称赞，但主要是推测性的且不恰当。它基于已被证伪的理论——消费者能够在当今网络信息经济中控制自己的在线体验。这种方案分散了改革者对解决结构性不对称问题的注意力。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了消费者控制在线体验的理论假设，提出了放弃用户控制虚幻承诺的理论转向，强调结构不对称而非个人控制的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者放弃对中间件解决方案的依赖，转而关注实施可执行的服务设计限制和商业监控实践监管，以解决社交媒体市场的结构性不对称问题。

reference: UNC Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
title: Algorithmic Synchronicity
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - University of North Carolina School of Law

detail.title: Algorithmic Synchronicity

publicationDetails.detailsText: UNC Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of North Carolina Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Predictive technologies increasingly generate experiences that feel like meaningful coincidences: a recommendation that appears at precisely the right moment, an advertisement that echoes an unspoken thought, or a dream cue that feels uncannily relevant. This Article terms these engineered experiences algorithmic synchronicities—moments in which computational systems create the illusion of significance by anticipating users’ thoughts, emotions, or imagery with sufficient precision and timing to appear meaningful. Using synchronicity in its descriptive sense as a meaningful coincidence, rather than as a metaphysical claim, the Article argues that law lacks a vocabulary for recognizing these experiences as a form of manipulation rather than mere personalization. It proposes algorithmic synchronicity as a doctrinal and evidentiary tool for identifying meaning-based privacy and consumer harms that evade notice-and-choice frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"算法同步性"概念，指算法通过精准预测用户想法、情绪或意象，在恰当时机创造看似有意义的巧合体验，这些体验感觉像是有意义的巧合但实际上是被工程化的操纵。
AI.research_question: 法律如何识别和应对算法通过创造"有意义的巧合"体验进行的操纵，而不仅仅是将其视为个性化服务？
AI.motivation: 预测性技术越来越能创造看似有意义的巧合体验（如恰当时机的推荐、反映未说出口想法的广告等），但法律缺乏识别这些体验作为操纵手段而非单纯个人化的词汇和框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"同步性"（有意义的巧合）的描述性概念，而非形而上学主张；将算法同步性作为识别基于意义的隐私和消费者伤害的理论框架。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论构建，提出"算法同步性"作为法律教义和证据工具。
AI.findings: 算法同步性揭示了现有"通知-选择"框架无法识别的隐私和消费者伤害类型，这些伤害源于算法创造的有意义巧合体验的操纵性本质。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"算法同步性"新概念，为法律提供识别算法操纵的词汇和理论框架；将同步性概念应用于算法系统分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实践提供识别算法操纵的教义和证据工具；帮助监管机构和法院识别逃避传统隐私保护框架的算法伤害。

title: Pressing Terrestrial Issues Versus Space Exploration: An Economic Lens

detail.title: Pressing Terrestrial Issues Versus Space Exploration: An Economic Lens
detail.abstract: How can large corporations and governments balance space exploration with pressing issues on Earth within an economic lens? This debate arises because opinions differ on whether funds should prioritize terrestrial issues like poverty and climate change or the exploration of space. Governments and corporations face challenges in decision making, as not all stakeholders,which for this issue include governments, private space companies such as SpaceX, taxpayers, economists, policymakers, and environmental advocates, agree on funding allocation. From an economic perspective, space exploration offers potential through resource collection and colonization on an alternate planet. However, the cost as well as the consumption of resources becomes a challenge. Conversely, investing in Earth’s preservation presents a compelling argument due to its widespread impact. Comparing the economic benefits of space exploration to the investment of funds to issues on Earth poses a challenge because of how many different perspectives there are, although there is a possibility of a viable solution.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨大型企业和政府如何在经济视角下平衡太空探索与地球紧迫问题，分析太空探索的经济潜力与地球问题投资的权衡，提出可能的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 大型企业和政府如何从经济角度平衡太空探索与地球紧迫问题（如贫困、气候变化）之间的资源分配？
AI.motivation: 关于资金应优先用于地球问题还是太空探索存在分歧，政府和企业面临决策挑战，各利益相关方（政府、私营太空公司、纳税人、经济学家、政策制定者、环保倡导者）对资金分配意见不一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济权衡理论、资源分配理论、利益相关者理论、成本效益分析框架
AI.method: 理论分析、多视角比较分析、利益相关者分析、经济成本效益评估
AI.findings: 太空探索具有资源获取和行星殖民的经济潜力，但面临高成本和资源消耗挑战；投资地球保护具有广泛影响；不同利益相关方视角差异显著，但可能存在可行的平衡解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 为太空探索与地球问题投资的经济权衡提供理论框架，整合利益相关者视角，提出平衡决策的分析模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和企业提供决策参考，帮助平衡太空探索与地球问题投资，促进多利益相关方共识，优化资源分配策略。

title: Deciphering Football Spectator No-Show Behavior: Insights from Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 Matches in Germany

detail.title: Deciphering Football Spectator No-Show Behavior: Insights from Bundesliga and Bundesliga 2 Matches in Germany
detail.abstract: This essay analyzes football spectator no-show behavior in Germany’s Bundesliga and 2. Bundesliga, focusing on how reported attendance can diverge from actual turnstile counts and why that gap matters for club revenue, stadium atmosphere, and demand estimation. Building on recent empirical work, I synthesize evidence that no-shows are systematically related to match characteristics (kick-off time, opponent quality, expected competitiveness), fan costs (travel distance, weather), and institutional features (season-ticket prevalence, resale frictions, and capacity constraints). I discuss how these factors bias standard demand models and can mislead pricing and operations decisions when clubs rely on tickets distributed rather than spectators present. I also assess policy responses—dynamic pricing tied to realized demand, easier verified resale, targeted nudges to season-ticket holders, and improved reporting standards—and outline implications for competitive balance and broadcast value. Overall, accounting for no-show behavior refines our understanding of football demand and yields more accurate guidance for clubs and leagues.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了德国足球联赛中观众"购票未到场"现象，探讨了报告上座率与实际到场人数的差异及其对俱乐部收入、球场氛围和需求估计的影响，并提出了政策建议。
AI.research_question: 德国足球联赛中观众"购票未到场"行为如何影响俱乐部收入、球场氛围和需求估计？哪些因素导致报告上座率与实际到场人数存在差异？
AI.motivation: 俱乐部通常依赖售出票数而非实际到场人数来制定定价和运营决策，这种差异可能导致需求估计偏差，影响俱乐部收入和球场氛围。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于实证研究，分析比赛特征（开球时间、对手质量、预期竞争性）、球迷成本（旅行距离、天气）和制度特征（季票普及率、转售障碍、容量限制）对未到场行为的系统性影响。
AI.method: 文献综述与实证证据综合分析方法，整合现有研究数据，分析未到场行为的影响因素及其对需求模型的偏差影响。
AI.findings: 未到场行为与多种因素系统性相关；依赖售出票数而非实际到场人数会扭曲标准需求模型，误导定价和运营决策；政策干预可改善这一现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 完善了对足球需求的理解，揭示了未到场行为对需求估计的系统性偏差，为体育经济学提供了更精确的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俱乐部和联赛提供政策建议：基于实际需求的动态定价、便利的验证转售、针对季票持有者的激励措施、改进报告标准，有助于提高收入、改善球场氛围和竞争平衡。

detail.abstract: This report presents the results of the Mack Institute’s study of the corporate venturing practices of the world’s 500 largest companies from the Forbes 2023 Global 2000 List, described in their annual reports and on corporate websites as of January 2024. We undertook this project to show the variety of ways in which corporations are scaling and broadening their interactions with startups. For corporations seeking to design or refine their startup engagement strategies, the report offers a valuable compass for navigating an increasingly sophisticated landscape. For entrepreneurs, it offers insight into the corporate approach to innovation and how startups fit into it.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了《福布斯》2023年全球2000强中500家最大企业的企业风险投资实践，展示了企业如何以多样化方式与初创公司互动，为企业设计初创企业参与策略提供指导，并为创业者提供企业创新方法的见解。

AI.motivation: 展示企业如何扩展和拓宽与初创公司的互动方式，为企业设计初创企业参与策略提供指导，并为创业者提供企业创新方法的见解。

AI.method: 基于《福布斯》2023年全球2000强中500家最大企业的年度报告和公司网站内容（截至2024年1月）进行内容分析

title: Four Questions about the Distributional Effects of Climate Policy
affiliations: Leipzig University and Uppsala University, Dept. of Economics

detail.title: Four Questions about the Distributional Effects of Climate Policy
detail.abstract:
Addressing the distributional effects of climate policy is one of the key challenges for securing a just and successful transition to carbon neutrality. Leaning on a large body of research, this paper answers four questions pertinent to understanding and counteracting the distributional effects of climate policy: 1) Why are the distributional effects of climate policy important? 2) Why do they arise? 3) What compensatory mechanisms and tools exist? 4) Which compensatory tools should be used? Our focus is on national, intragenerational distributional effects and policy.

We demonstrate that, while previous research has primarily examined the distributional effects of carbon pricing, the transition to carbon neutrality, which we refer to as the “climate transition,” generates numerous other distributional effects that are largely understudied. We further highlight that what makes the climate transition different from other technological transitions is that it affects households’ costs, e.g., via carbon pricing, rather than households’ income through, e.g., job loss. This implies that welfare systems in most countries, which are geared towards handling income shocks, are not well-equipped to handle the distributional effects of climate policy. Our mapping reveals, at least tentatively, that those households and individuals who bear the highest relative costs of climate policy (rural, low-income households) are also those who reap less of its material and health benefits and care the least about mitigating global climate damage for intergenerational sustainability. This observation, along with welfare systems that fail to adjust to cost shocks, may rationalize the political backlash.

We conceptually posit three desirable characteristics for compensatory measures: they should be efficient, precisely targeted, and visible. We evaluate the policy toolkit based on these characteristics and illustrate how achieving them may be mutually exclusive. While there exist potent and common tools to compensate low-income households, e.g., progressive income taxes, the tools for compensating for the geographical distributional effects are scarce and may imply inefficiencies. In summary, our review identifies several gaps in the current scientific literature and provides a mapping of available policies to help policymakers decide on when and why to use different measures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了气候政策的分配效应及其补偿机制，指出气候转型与传统技术转型不同，主要通过成本而非收入影响家庭，现有福利体系难以应对，并提出了补偿措施的三个理想特征。
AI.research_question: 1) 气候政策的分配效应为何重要？2) 这些分配效应如何产生？3) 存在哪些补偿机制和工具？4) 应使用哪些补偿工具？
AI.motivation: 解决气候政策的分配效应是实现公正、成功碳中和转型的关键挑战。现有研究主要关注碳定价的分配效应，但碳中和转型会产生许多其他未被充分研究的分配效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候转型的分配效应理论，强调气候转型与传统技术转型的区别（成本影响vs收入影响），福利体系对收入冲击的适应性分析，补偿措施的三个理想特征框架（效率性、精准性、可见性）。
AI.method: 文献综述与概念分析，系统梳理现有研究，识别研究空白，对气候政策的分配效应进行系统性映射分析。
AI.findings: 1) 气候转型主要通过成本而非收入影响家庭，现有福利体系难以应对成本冲击；2) 承受最高相对成本的家庭（农村、低收入）获得物质和健康收益较少，且最不关心代际可持续性；3) 补偿措施存在效率性、精准性和可见性之间的权衡；4) 补偿低收入家庭的工具较多，但补偿地理分配效应的工具稀缺且可能低效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了气候政策分配效应的理论框架，超越碳定价；2) 提出了气候转型与传统技术转型的理论区分；3) 建立了补偿措施的三个理想特征分析框架；4) 揭示了分配效应与政治反弹之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供了补偿工具的选择框架；2) 识别了当前科学文献的研究空白；3) 提供了政策映射帮助决策者决定何时使用何种措施；4) 强调了福利体系适应气候政策成本冲击的必要性。

title: Release Behavior and Risk Assessment of Heavy Metals from Nitric Acid Leach Residue of Phosphate Ore
affiliations: Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou Minzu University and Guizhou University

detail.title: Release Behavior and Risk Assessment of Heavy Metals from Nitric Acid Leach Residue of Phosphate Ore
detail.abstract: Nitric acid-based wet-process phosphoric acid production has emerged as an industry priority for resource efficiency and environmental sustainability, yet heavy metal control in its byproduct-acid leaching residue-remains a critical bottleneck for safe disposal and valorization. This study systematically elucidated environmental behavior and health risks of heavy metals through mineralogical characterization, dynamic leaching experiments, and multi-dimensional risk assessment. Results revealed quartz, fluorite, and magnesium phosphate as dominant crystalline phases coexisting with amorphous silicates. Among hazardous elements (As, Cr, Pb, Hg, Cd), arsenic leachate exceeded GB 18599-2020 limits; cadmium and arsenic exhibited elevated labile fractions with pronounced short-term mobility risk, whereas lead, mercury, and chromium were predominantly residual, implying attenuated immediate risk. Leaching experiments unveiled a 'rapid dissolution-diffusion controlled' release pattern reaching dynamic equilibrium within 7 days under deionized water; acid conditions triggered a 'delayed surge' in As, Cr, and Pb. Ecological risk ranking was Hg > Cd > As > Cr > Pb, with mercury posing maximal threat. Health risk assessment confirmed carcinogenic risks from Cr, Pb, Cd, and As to both children and adults, with As as the principal contributor. Collectively, despite classification as non-hazardous waste, acid leaching residue poses substantial heavy metal-associated hazards, necessitating risk mitigation via solidification or extraction prior to realizing its P, K, and N-rich valorization potential. This study furnishes a robust theoretical foundation for safe disposal and resource utilization.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统阐明了硝酸法湿法磷酸生产过程中酸浸残渣的重金属环境行为和健康风险，发现砷浸出超标，镉和砷具有高迁移风险，汞生态风险最大，所有重金属均存在致癌风险，需固化或提取处理才能实现资源化利用。
AI.research_question: 硝酸法湿法磷酸生产过程中产生的酸浸残渣中重金属的环境行为和健康风险是什么？如何实现其安全处置和资源化利用？
AI.motivation: 硝酸法湿法磷酸生产因其资源效率和环境可持续性成为行业重点，但其副产物酸浸残渣中的重金属控制是安全处置和资源化利用的关键瓶颈，需要系统评估其环境行为和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重金属环境行为理论、矿物学表征理论、动态浸出动力学理论、生态风险评估理论、健康风险评估理论、废物资源化理论
AI.method: 采用矿物学表征（XRD等）、动态浸出实验（去离子水和酸性条件下）、多维风险评估（生态风险和健康风险评估）相结合的系统研究方法
AI.findings: 1. 主要矿物相为石英、萤石和磷酸镁，与无定形硅酸盐共存；2. 砷浸出超过GB 18599-2020限值；3. 镉和砷具有高活性组分和短期迁移风险；4. 铅、汞和铬主要为残渣态，即时风险较低；5. 浸出呈现"快速溶解-扩散控制"模式，7天内达到动态平衡；6. 酸性条件引发砷、铬、铅的"延迟激增"；7. 生态风险排序：汞>镉>砷>铬>铅；8. 健康风险评估显示铬、铅、镉、砷对儿童和成人均有致癌风险，砷为主要贡献者
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统阐明了硝酸法湿法磷酸酸浸残渣中重金属的环境行为特征；2. 揭示了重金属在不同环境条件下的浸出动力学机制；3. 建立了酸浸残渣重金属多维风险评估框架；4. 为工业副产物重金属风险控制提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别了酸浸残渣中关键风险重金属（砷、汞、镉）；2. 提供了重金属风险排序和优先控制目标；3. 提出了通过固化或提取处理实现安全处置和资源化利用的技术路径；4. 为相关行业标准和监管政策制定提供了科学依据

title: Do Patents Predict Innovation?
affiliations: and University of California, Berkeley - Agricultural & Resource Economics

detail.title: Do Patents Predict Innovation?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this study
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding

publicationDetails.detailsText: UC Berkeley Public Law Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Berkeley School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: There is a large academic literature that addresses whether patents are good measures of the innovations they cover. A related question that the literature has not addressed is whether existing patents are reliable predictors of future innovation in technological areas covered by the patents. The answer to this question is relevant to studies that might attempt to predict firm performance or the consequences of mergers or other conduct on innovation. We report data on patents that cover synthetic pesticides and compare the patent data to new pesticides that have been developed after the patents were filed. These patents are highly imperfect predictors of subsequent innovations. We explain the reasons for this result and why they apply to other industries to make patents unreliable predictors of innovation.

AI.tldr: 专利数据作为未来创新的预测指标可靠性不足，特别是在农药行业，专利与后续实际创新之间存在显著差距。
AI.research_question: 现有专利是否能够可靠预测其覆盖技术领域未来的创新？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注专利是否能够准确衡量其所覆盖的创新，但缺乏对专利作为未来创新预测指标可靠性的研究。这个问题对于预测企业绩效、并购影响以及其他创新相关研究具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利作为创新指标的理论基础，专利与创新之间的关系理论，以及专利预测能力的局限性理论。
AI.method: 采用合成农药行业的专利数据，比较专利申请后实际开发出的新农药产品，分析专利数据与实际创新之间的匹配程度。
AI.findings: 专利是后续创新的高度不完美预测指标。在合成农药行业，专利数据与实际开发出的新农药之间存在显著差距，专利不能可靠预测未来的创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统探讨专利作为未来创新预测指标的可靠性问题，揭示了专利预测能力的局限性，为专利与创新关系理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者和实践者在预测企业绩效、评估并购影响或分析创新趋势时，不应过度依赖专利数据作为未来创新的预测指标。这一发现在其他行业也具有普遍适用性。

title: Home-Market Advantage and the EV Transition Evidence from EU Car Markets, 2014–2022
affiliations: Carl von Ossietzky University of Oldenburg

detail.title: Home-Market Advantage and the EV Transition Evidence from EU Car Markets, 2014–2022
detail.abstract: We document home-market advantage in European automobile markets and its interaction with the EV transition. Using brand-by-country monthly registrations for the EU27, 2014–2022, matched to statute-dated EV policy episodes (subsidies, bonus–malus, scrappage), we estimate PPML and market-share models with saturated fixed effects, Sun– Abraham event-time designs—including a triple difference (DDD)—and border-pair fixed effects. Three findings emerge. First, baseline home-market advantages are considerable across fuels. Second, around national EV policy onsets, extensive and intensive margins diverge: overall EV sales surge, but domestic brands’ within-brand EV shares fall by roughly 6–13 percentage points, and the Domestic × EV effect turns negative, reaching about −17 pp by year three under clean pre-trends. Third, heterogeneity is pronounced — effects are more potent in producer, richer, and infrastructure-dense markets. We interpret this as an incumbency disadvantage during technological transition: policies expand EV demand, yet foreign EV specialists capture a disproportionate share.

AI.tldr: 研究发现欧洲汽车市场存在本土市场优势，但在电动汽车转型过程中，本土品牌面临"在位者劣势"：虽然EV政策刺激了整体电动汽车销售，但外国EV专家品牌获得了不成比例的市场份额，本土品牌的EV份额反而下降。
AI.research_question: 欧洲汽车市场的本土市场优势如何与电动汽车转型相互作用？具体而言，EV政策如何影响本土品牌和外国品牌在电动汽车市场的竞争格局？
AI.motivation: 随着欧洲各国推行电动汽车政策（补贴、奖惩机制、报废计划），需要了解这些政策如何改变汽车市场的竞争动态，特别是对本土品牌和外国品牌在传统燃油车和电动汽车市场中的相对表现的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 本土市场优势理论（Home-market advantage）
2. 技术转型中的在位者劣势（Incumbency disadvantage during technological transition）
3. 政策干预对市场结构的影响
AI.method: 使用2014-2022年欧盟27国品牌×国家的月度注册数据，匹配政策实施时间点（补贴、奖惩机制、报废计划）。采用PPML和市场份额模型，包含饱和固定效应、Sun-Abraham事件时间设计（包括三重差分DDD）和边界对固定效应。
AI.findings:
1. 基线本土市场优势在所有燃料类型中都相当显著
2. 在国家EV政策实施期间，扩展边际和集约边际出现分化：整体EV销售激增，但本土品牌的EV份额下降约6-13个百分点，本土×EV效应转为负值（三年后约-17个百分点）
3. 异质性明显：在生产国、较富裕和基础设施密集的市场中效应更强
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了技术转型中的"在位者劣势"概念，解释了为什么本土品牌在EV政策刺激下反而失去市场份额
2. 丰富了本土市场优势理论，展示了其在技术转型背景下的动态变化
3. 为政策干预与市场竞争的相互作用提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供启示：EV政策可能无意中削弱本土汽车制造商的竞争力
2. 为汽车企业战略提供指导：本土品牌需要更积极地应对EV转型，避免被外国EV专家品牌超越
3. 为投资者提供市场动态分析：识别在EV转型中可能受益或受损的企业

title: Why Bubbles Occur: Revisiting the Rationality Debate
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago

detail.title: Why Bubbles Occur: Revisiting the Rationality Debate

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: I argue that rather than a contest between models with exclusively rational agents and models where at least some traders hold irrational beliefs, the theoretical literature on overvalued assets, or asset bubbles, is better understood as a contest between models where rational agents have symmetric information and models where agents—whether rational or irrational—hold different beliefs from one another. Models where agents are both rational and hold different beliefs can give rise to robust and empirically plausible bubbles that are similar to the bubbles that can arise when some agents are irrational.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为资产泡沫理论文献的核心争议不是理性vs非理性模型，而是对称信息vs异质信念模型。异质信念下的理性代理人也能产生与非理性模型相似的稳健且经验上合理的泡沫。
AI.research_question: 资产泡沫理论文献中，理性vs非理性模型的争议是否掩盖了更根本的对称信息vs异质信念的区分？异质信念下的理性代理人能否产生与非理性模型相似的资产泡沫？
AI.motivation: 传统上资产泡沫理论被划分为理性模型和非理性模型的对立，但作者认为这种划分忽略了信息结构和信念异质性的重要性。需要重新审视泡沫理论的基本框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、泡沫理论、理性预期理论、异质信念理论、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 理论分析与文献综述方法，通过逻辑论证和理论模型比较来阐述观点
AI.findings: 1. 资产泡沫理论的核心区分不是理性vs非理性，而是对称信息vs异质信念；2. 在异质信念条件下，即使所有代理人都是理性的，也能产生与非理性模型相似的稳健泡沫；3. 这种框架能更好地解释经验观察到的泡沫现象
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新构建了资产泡沫理论的分类框架；2. 强调了异质信念在泡沫形成中的核心作用；3. 挑战了传统理性vs非理性的二元对立观点；4. 为理性代理人模型提供了产生泡沫的新解释机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解泡沫形成机制提供新视角；2. 帮助投资者识别不同信念环境下的市场风险；3. 为金融市场监管提供理论依据；4. 促进对市场效率的重新评估

title: Investment in Emerging and Developing Economies
affiliations: , World Bank and World Bank

detail.title: Investment in Emerging and Developing Economies

declarations.funderStatement: Policy and Human Resources Development (PHRD) fund

detail.abstract: The world faces a pressing challenge to meet key development objectives amid slowing growth and rising macroeconomic and geopolitical risks. With the number of job seekers rising rapidly, infrastructure shortfalls continuing to be large, and climate costs mounting, the case for a significant investment push has never been stronger. Yet the capacity to respond in many emerging market and developing economies (EMDEs) has eroded. Since the global financial crisis, investment growth has slowed to about half its pace in the 2000s, with both public and private investment weakening. Foreign direct investment inflows—a critical source of capital, technology, and managerial know-how—have also fallen sharply and become increasingly concentrated, leaving low-income countries (LICs) with only a marginal share. The risks of further retrenchment are significant, as trade tensions, policy uncertainty, and elevated debt levels continue to weigh on investment. Reigniting momentum will require ambitious domestic reforms to strengthen institutions, rebuild macro-fiscal stability, and deepen trade and investment integration—the foundations of a supportive business climate. At the same time, international cooperation is indispensable. A renewed commitment to a predictable system of cross-border trade and investment flows, combined with scaled-up financial support and sustained technical assistance, is essential to help EMDEs—especially LICs and economies in fragile and conflict situations—bridge financing gaps and implement the domestic reforms needed to restore investment as an engine of growth, jobs, and development.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨新兴市场和发展中经济体面临的投资放缓挑战，分析其成因并提出通过国内改革与国际合作相结合的方式重振投资增长，以促进就业和发展的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场和发展中经济体投资增长放缓的原因是什么？如何通过国内改革和国际合作重振投资，使其重新成为增长、就业和发展的引擎？
AI.motivation: 全球面临增长放缓、宏观经济和地缘政治风险上升的挑战，同时就业需求增加、基础设施缺口巨大、气候成本攀升，迫切需要大规模投资。然而许多新兴市场和发展中经济体的投资能力却在减弱，投资增长自全球金融危机以来已减半，外国直接投资大幅下降且日益集中，低收入国家份额微乎其微。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于发展经济学和国际投资理论，分析投资对经济增长、就业创造和发展的引擎作用；运用制度经济学理论探讨机构质量、宏观经济稳定对投资环境的影响；结合国际政治经济学分析贸易紧张、政策不确定性和债务水平对投资决策的影响。
AI.method: 采用宏观数据分析方法，比较全球金融危机前后投资增长趋势；运用案例分析方法研究不同国家投资模式变化；通过政策分析评估国内改革和国际合作的有效性。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）新兴市场和发展中经济体投资增长自2000年代以来减半；2）公共和私人投资均疲软；3）外国直接投资大幅下降且日益集中，低收入国家份额极小；4）贸易紧张、政策不确定性和高债务水平持续抑制投资；5）重振投资需要国内改革（加强机构、重建宏观财政稳定、深化贸易投资一体化）和国际合作（可预测的跨境贸易投资体系、扩大金融支持、持续技术援助）相结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）系统分析后危机时代新兴市场和发展中经济体投资放缓的多维原因；2）提出"国内改革-国际合作"双轨框架重振投资的理论模型；3）深化对脆弱和冲突局势经济体特殊投资挑战的理解；4）拓展投资作为增长、就业和发展引擎的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为政策制定者提供重振投资的具体改革路径；2）提出加强国际合作的可行方案；3）为低收入国家和脆弱经济体提供针对性支持建议；4）为弥合融资缺口、促进可持续发展提供操作指南；5）为应对气候变化和基础设施需求的投资策略提供参考。

title: Winners and Losers: Competition, Creative Destruction, and Labor Income Risk
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, Kellogg School of Management - Department of Finance and MIT Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Winners and Losers: Competition, Creative Destruction, and Labor Income Risk
detail.abstract: Using U.S. administrative data, we find that technology-driven creative destruction in the product market passes through to worker earnings. The passthrough to incumbent worker earnings is both asymmetric and concentrated: profit drops from rival innovations lead to proportionally greater earning declines and changes in the likelihood of job destruction than profit gains from their own firm's innovations, while top workers are significantly more exposed than the average worker. We develop an endogenous-growth model with monopsonistic labor markets and worker heterogeneity that replicates this asymmetry and the distribution of earnings risk. Creative destruction exposes high-income workers to concentrated downside risk while offering lower-income workers upward mobility, shaping the welfare consequences of innovation policy.

AI.tldr: 使用美国行政数据研究发现，产品市场的技术驱动型创造性破坏会影响工人收入。这种传递效应具有不对称性和集中性：竞争对手创新导致的利润下降比本企业创新带来的利润增长对工人收入和工作破坏可能性的影响更大，且顶尖工人比普通工人面临更大风险。研究开发了一个具有垄断性劳动力市场和工人异质性的内生增长模型来解释这种不对称性和收入风险分布。
AI.research_question: 技术驱动的创造性破坏如何影响工人收入？这种影响在不同工人群体间如何分布？
AI.motivation: 理解创新对劳动力市场的影响，特别是创造性破坏如何在不同收入水平的工人之间分配风险和机会，对于制定有效的创新政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生增长理论、垄断性劳动力市场理论、工人异质性理论、创造性破坏理论
AI.method: 使用美国行政数据分析技术驱动型创造性破坏对工人收入的影响，并开发内生增长模型解释观察到的模式
AI.findings: 1. 创造性破坏对工人收入的影响具有不对称性：竞争对手创新导致的利润下降比本企业创新带来的利润增长对工人收入和工作破坏可能性的影响更大；2. 风险分布不均：顶尖工人比普通工人面临更大的收入风险；3. 创造性破坏使高收入工人面临集中的下行风险，同时为低收入工人提供向上流动的机会
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了一个结合垄断性劳动力市场和工人异质性的内生增长模型；2. 解释了创造性破坏对工人收入影响的不对称性；3. 揭示了创新风险在不同收入群体间的分布模式
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了关于创新政策福利后果的新视角；2. 揭示了创新对不同收入群体的差异化影响；3. 有助于设计更公平的创新政策，平衡创新激励与工人保护

title: The Name Game: How Contractual Form, Not Reserve Ratios, Defines Money

detail.title: The Name Game: How Contractual Form, Not Reserve Ratios, Defines Money
detail.abstract: For nearly a century, the Austrian School has been fractured by the seemingly intractable debate over fractional-reserve banking (FRB), pitting proponents of a 100% reserve requirement, who view FRB as institutionalized fraud, against free-banking advocates, who see it as a legitimate market innovation. This paper argues that this entire debate is rooted in a fundamental category mistake: it has treated a problem of jurisprudence and contract law as if it were a matter of economic theory. We demonstrate through a thought experiment—termed "the name game"—that any legal prohibition against fractional-reserve banking is practically futile. The market, driven by the persistent demand for interest-bearing liquid assets, will inevitably circumvent such a restriction by re-creating the same economic function under a new institutional form (e.g., a "loan fund" instead of a "bank"). This phenomenon is not merely theoretical, as evidenced by the historical emergence of money market funds and the shadow banking system to bypass financial regulations. The conclusion is stark: the war against FRB was a semantic one, and the market has already won. The true locus of analysis, therefore, must shift from the institution to the instrument—from the "bank" to the "contract." This paper contends that the valid concerns of both the Rothbardian and free-banking camps can be reconciled under a new, unified framework centered on contractual clarity and honest labeling. The real issue is not the reserve ratio, but whether a financial instrument is honestly represented as a secure bailment or an at-risk investment. By re-founding the debate on this contractual-legal basis, we can transcend the historical deadlock and unite the Austrian School against its true enemy: the systemic contractual opacity fostered by the modern, state-backed financial system.

AI.tldr: 奥地利学派关于部分准备金银行制的百年争论源于范畴错误——将法律契约问题误作经济理论问题。市场对生息流动资产的需求必然规避任何法律禁令，通过新制度形式（如"贷款基金"替代"银行"）重现相同经济功能。真正问题不是准备金率，而是金融工具是否诚实地表示为安全寄托或有风险投资。应将争论重新建立在契约法律基础上，聚焦合同清晰度和诚实标签。
AI.research_question: 奥地利学派关于部分准备金银行制的百年争论为何陷入僵局？如何超越这一僵局，为奥地利学派提供统一的分析框架？
AI.motivation: 奥地利学派内部关于部分准备金银行制的争论已持续近一个世纪，形成了支持100%准备金要求（视FRB为制度性欺诈）和自由银行倡导者（视FRB为合法市场创新）的对立阵营。这一争论阻碍了奥地利学派的统一和发展。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 范畴错误理论：将法律和契约问题误作经济理论问题
2. 市场规避理论：市场对生息流动资产的需求会规避监管限制
3. 契约法律框架：金融工具应基于契约清晰度和诚实标签来评估
AI.method:
1. 思想实验："命名游戏"论证法律禁令的无效性
2. 历史案例分析：货币市场基金和影子银行系统的出现作为市场规避监管的证据
3. 概念分析：从制度分析转向工具分析，从"银行"转向"合同"
AI.findings:
1. 任何法律禁止部分准备金银行制的尝试都是徒劳的，市场会通过新制度形式规避限制
2. 反对FRB的战争本质上是语义战争，市场已经获胜
3. 真正问题不是准备金率，而是金融工具是否诚实地表示为安全寄托或有风险投资
4. 罗斯巴德学派和自由银行学派的有效关切可以在契约清晰度的新框架下调和
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 识别并纠正了奥地利学派FRB争论中的范畴错误
2. 提出了从制度分析转向契约分析的范式转变
3. 为奥地利学派提供了超越历史僵局的统一分析框架
4. 重新定义了金融监管的核心问题：契约透明度而非准备金率
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了更有效的监管方向：关注合同清晰度和诚实标签
2. 帮助投资者更好地理解不同金融工具的风险性质
3. 为金融创新提供了清晰的伦理和法律指导原则
4. 指出了现代国家支持金融体系中系统性契约不透明度的真正问题

title: Letters of Recommendation in the PhD Job Market: Lessons from Specialized Banks
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Letters of Recommendation in the PhD Job Market: Lessons from Specialized Banks

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Banks must extract useful signals of a potential borrower’s quality from a large set of possibly informative characteristics when making lending decisions. A model that speaks to how banks specialize in lending to an industry in order to better extract signals from data, can potentially be applied to a number of real-world scenarios. In this post, we apply lessons from such a model to a topic of timely relevance in economics: job market recommendation letters. Institutions looking to hire new economists must evaluate PhD applicants based on limited and often noisy signals of future performance, including letters of recommendation from these applicants’ advisors or co-authors. Using insights from our model, we argue that the value of these letters depends on who reads them.

To view post:/https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2025/12/letters-of-recommendation-in-the-phd-job-market-lessons-from-specialized-banks/

AI.tldr: 该研究将银行专业化贷款的信号提取模型应用于经济学博士就业市场的推荐信评估，探讨推荐信的价值如何取决于阅读者的专业背景。
AI.research_question: 在经济学博士就业市场中，推荐信的价值如何受到阅读者专业背景的影响？
AI.motivation: 经济学博士就业市场中，招聘机构需要基于有限且嘈杂的信号（包括推荐信）来评估申请者未来的表现。银行在贷款决策中通过专业化来更好地从数据中提取信号，这一模型可以应用于推荐信评估场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行专业化贷款的信号提取理论：银行通过专注于特定行业来发展专业知识，从而更有效地从借款人的众多特征中提取有用信号。
AI.method: 理论模型应用分析：将银行专业化贷款的信号提取模型类比应用于经济学博士就业市场的推荐信评估场景。
AI.findings: 推荐信的价值取决于谁阅读它们。具有相关专业背景的阅读者能够更好地从推荐信中提取有用信号，类似于银行通过行业专业化提高信号提取能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融领域的信号提取理论扩展到劳动力市场评估领域，为推荐信的价值评估提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学博士就业市场的招聘实践提供指导：建议招聘机构考虑阅读者的专业背景对推荐信解读的影响，优化招聘决策过程。

title: Collaboration between Village-Owned Enterprises and the Private Sector in Sustainable Village Tourism Development through the PPP-DBFOM Scheme: A Case Study of Kutuh Village, Badung Regency

detail.title: Collaboration between Village-Owned Enterprises and the Private Sector in Sustainable Village Tourism Development through the PPP-DBFOM Scheme: A Case Study of Kutuh Village, Badung Regency
detail.abstract: This study analyzes the collaboration between Village-Owned Enterprises (BUMDes) and the private sector in the development of sustainable village tourism through the application of a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) scheme with a Design-Build-Finance-Operate-Maintain (DBFOM) model. The approach used is a conceptual literature review by reviewing more than 15 relevant national and international journals, as well as secondary sources from institutions such as the OECD, World Bank, and UNWTO. The analysis focuses on the integration of collaborative governance, new public governance, public accountability, and creating shared value (CSV) theories to formulate a conceptual framework for collaboration at the village level. The results of the study show that the success of BUMDes-Private collaboration is determined by four main factors: (1) transparent and participatory collaborative governance, (2) trust and communication between actors, (3) fair distribution of risks and benefits, and (4) institutional capacity and managerial innovation of BUMDes. The case study of Kutuh Village, Badung Regency, Bali, serves as an empirical illustration that confirms the effectiveness of the PPP-DBFOM model on a micro scale. Collaboration in this village has succeeded in increasing economic efficiency, strengthening local institutions, and promoting socio-environmental sustainability through the application of benefit-sharing principles and community participation. Conceptually, the results of this study expand the application of PPP in the context of the village economy by emphasizing the importance of collaborative governance based on shared values. These findings also provide policy implications for strengthening the capacity of BUMDes, adaptive contract design, and the formulation of public policies that support cross-sector collaboration towards inclusive and sustainable village tourism development.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过文献综述和案例分析，探讨了乡村企业（BUMDes）与私营部门在可持续乡村旅游发展中应用PPP-DBFOM模式的合作机制，识别了成功合作的四个关键因素，并以巴厘岛Kutuh村为例验证了该模式在微观层面的有效性。
AI.research_question: 乡村企业（BUMDes）与私营部门如何通过PPP-DBFOM模式有效合作，推动可持续乡村旅游发展？
AI.motivation: 探索在乡村层面实施PPP模式的有效途径，以促进可持续乡村旅游发展，同时加强地方机构能力，实现经济、社会和环境的协调发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了协作治理理论、新公共治理理论、公共问责理论和创造共享价值（CSV）理论，构建了乡村层面的合作概念框架。
AI.method: 采用概念性文献综述方法，回顾了超过15篇相关的国内外期刊文献，以及OECD、世界银行、UNWTO等机构的二手资料，并结合巴厘岛Badung县Kutuh村的案例研究进行实证分析。
AI.findings: BUMDes与私营部门合作的成功取决于四个主要因素：1）透明和参与式的协作治理；2）行动者之间的信任和沟通；3）风险和收益的公平分配；4）BUMDes的机构能力和管理创新。Kutuh村的案例证实了PPP-DBFOM模式在微观层面的有效性，提高了经济效率，加强了地方机构，促进了社会环境的可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了PPP在乡村经济背景下的应用，强调了基于共享价值的协作治理的重要性，为乡村层面的跨部门合作提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了加强BUMDes能力建设、适应性合同设计以及支持跨部门合作的公共政策建议，促进包容性和可持续的乡村旅游发展。

title: Belgian wealth inequality, 1935-2022
affiliations: Department of Economics, UGent-Ghent University

detail.title: Belgian wealth inequality, 1935-2022

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In the absence of a wealth register, Belgian wealth inequality needs to be estimated. Here I apply the mortality multiplier approach to Belgian inheritance tax tabulations and administrative microdata, collectively covering 1935 to 2022. Belgian wealth inequality has strongly declined during the 20th century and seems relatively stable in recent years. I triangulate my estimates with national accounts aggregates and previous work on Belgian wealth inequality. The evolution of Belgian wealth inequality is in line with other European countries for which long-run estimates are available.

AI.tldr: 本文使用死亡率乘数法估计比利时财富不平等，覆盖1935-2022年，发现20世纪财富不平等显著下降，近年相对稳定，与其他欧洲国家趋势一致。
AI.research_question: 比利时财富不平等在长期（1935-2022年）如何演变？
AI.motivation: 比利时缺乏财富登记制度，需要可靠方法来估计财富不平等状况及其长期变化趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财富不平等测量理论，死亡率乘数法（mortality multiplier approach）在财富估计中的应用。
AI.method: 应用死亡率乘数法分析比利时遗产税统计表和管理微观数据，覆盖1935-2022年，并与国民账户总量及前人研究进行三角验证。
AI.findings: 比利时财富不平等在20世纪显著下降，近年来相对稳定，与其他有长期数据的欧洲国家趋势一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为缺乏财富登记制度的国家提供了长期财富不平等估计的方法论框架和实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为比利时政策制定者提供了长期财富不平等演变的历史视角，有助于财富分配政策的制定和评估。

title: Hormone Replacement Therapy is Associated with Decreased Risk of Running Away Among Transgender Adolescents
affiliations: Southern Oregon University and Rutgers University - School of Management and Labor Relations

detail.title: Hormone Replacement Therapy is Associated with Decreased Risk of Running Away Among Transgender Adolescents

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None of the co-authors have a conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The project received IRB approval from Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey (Study ID: Pro2021000636).
declarations.funderStatement: None of the co-authors of this manuscript received funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Using data from the 2015 US Transgender Survey, this study estimates the association between hormone replacement therapy (HRT) initiation and the risk of running away among transgender adolescents (ages 14-17). Our event study approach compares youths who started HRT (treated group) with those who initiated HRT a year later (control group). HRT is associated with a 2 percentage point reduction in the risk of running away from home during the first year of treatment (a 20 percent decrease relative to the pretreatment mean). The association is largest for adolescents who initiate HRT at younger ages (14–15).

AI.tldr: 使用2015年美国跨性别调查数据，研究发现激素替代疗法（HRT）启动与跨性别青少年（14-17岁）离家出走风险降低相关，第一年风险降低2个百分点（相对治疗前均值下降20%），年龄越小效果越明显。
AI.research_question: 激素替代疗法（HRT）启动是否与跨性别青少年离家出走风险相关？
AI.motivation: 跨性别青少年面临较高的心理健康风险和家庭冲突，需要了解医疗干预（如HRT）如何影响他们的行为结果，特别是离家出走这一高风险行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别肯定医疗干预对心理健康和行为结果的影响理论；青春期身份认同发展与家庭关系动态。
AI.method: 使用2015年美国跨性别调查数据，采用事件研究法，比较开始HRT的青少年（处理组）与一年后开始HRT的青少年（控制组）。
AI.findings: HRT与第一年离家出走风险降低2个百分点相关（相对治疗前均值下降20%）；效果在14-15岁开始治疗的青少年中最为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 为性别肯定医疗干预对青少年行为结果的影响提供了实证证据；支持早期医疗干预对跨性别青少年福祉的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床医生、政策制定者和家庭提供证据，支持及时提供HRT可能降低跨性别青少年高风险行为；强调年龄因素在干预效果中的重要性。

title: Who Manages the Household Purse? Factors Shaping Payment Task Allocation between Partners and its Implications
affiliations: De Nederlandsche Bank, Ministerie van Financiën and Ministerie van Financiën

detail.title: Who Manages the Household Purse? Factors Shaping Payment Task Allocation between Partners and its Implications

publicationDetails.detailsText: De Nederlandsche Bank Working Paper No. 851
publicationDetails.journalName: De Nederlandsche Bank Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study highlights the multifaceted nature of household payment task division, revealing that a broad spectrum of factors contributes to who takes the lead in executing household payments. The allocation of specific payment tasks is related to partners’ differences in personality traits, enjoyment of payment tasks and available time. Disparities in income and assets also play a significant role, alongside differences in payment knowledge, digital payment experience, and money management skills. Furthermore, individuals tend to replicate the division of payment tasks observed in others. Traditional patterns whereby men manage housing-related payments and women handle grocery expenses, appear across all generations but are most prevalent among the oldest. Greater involvement in household payment tasks is associated with increased financial influence within the household. It also facilitates the ability to take over a partner’s payment responsibilities when needed and enhances early awareness of potential financial issues. In a substantial number of households, one partner is solely responsible for managing specific payments. Strong payment knowledge, digital payment experience, and staying informed about the partner’s payment activities support a smooth transition of responsibilities when necessary.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了家庭支付任务分工的多维性，发现多种因素共同决定谁主导家庭支付。支付任务分配与伴侣的性格特质差异、对支付任务的享受程度、可用时间、收入资产差异、支付知识、数字支付经验和理财技能相关。传统性别分工模式在所有世代中都存在，但在最年长群体中最普遍。更多参与支付任务与更强的家庭财务影响力相关，并能促进在需要时接管伴侣支付责任的能力，以及更早发现潜在财务问题。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素决定家庭中谁主导支付任务的分配？家庭支付任务分工如何影响伴侣间的财务关系和家庭财务管理？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭支付任务分工的复杂性及其对家庭财务动态的影响，填补对家庭内部财务分工机制研究的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭财务分工理论、性别角色理论、资源依赖理论、社会学习理论
AI.method: 实证研究（可能采用问卷调查或访谈方法），分析家庭支付任务分配的决定因素及其后果
AI.findings:
1. 支付任务分配受多种因素影响：性格特质差异、任务享受度、可用时间、收入资产差异、支付知识、数字支付经验、理财技能
2. 传统性别分工模式（男性管住房支付、女性管杂货支出）在所有世代存在，但在最年长群体中最普遍
3. 更多参与支付任务与更强的家庭财务影响力相关
4. 支付参与度高能促进在需要时接管伴侣支付责任的能力
5. 支付参与度高能增强对潜在财务问题的早期意识
6. 许多家庭中一方单独负责特定支付任务
7. 支付知识、数字支付经验和了解伴侣支付活动有助于责任平稳过渡
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了家庭财务分工理论，识别了影响支付任务分配的多维因素
2. 验证了传统性别角色在支付分工中的持续性
3. 揭示了支付任务参与与财务影响力之间的关联机制
4. 提出了支付能力对家庭财务韧性的重要性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 帮助家庭理解支付分工的影响因素，促进更平衡的财务安排

reference: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.25-070
title: Inference for Batched Adaptive Experiments
affiliations: ZEW Mannheim and University of Mannheim

detail.title: Inference for Batched Adaptive Experiments

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.25-070
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: The advantages of adaptive experiments have led to their rapid adoption in economics, other fields, as well as among practitioners. However, adaptive experiments pose challenges for causal inference. This note suggests a BOLS (batched ordinary least squares) test statistic for inference of treatment effects in adaptive experiments. The statistic provides a precisionequalizing aggregation of per-period treatment-control differences under heteroskedasticity. The combined test statistic is a normalized average of heteroskedastic per-period z-statistics and can be used to construct asymptotically valid confidence intervals. We provide simulation results comparing rejection rates in the typical case with few treatment periods and few (or many) observations per batch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种BOLS（分批普通最小二乘法）检验统计量，用于自适应实验中的因果推断，通过异方差下的精度均衡聚合处理效应差异，构建渐近有效的置信区间。
AI.research_question: 如何在自适应实验中有效推断处理效应，特别是在异方差条件下构建有效的检验统计量和置信区间？
AI.motivation: 自适应实验在经济学等领域的快速应用带来了因果推断的挑战，需要开发适用于这种实验设计的统计推断方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分批普通最小二乘法（BOLS）理论框架，结合异方差条件下的统计推断理论，构建精度均衡的聚合统计量。
AI.method: 提出BOLS检验统计量，将异方差条件下各时期的处理-控制差异进行精度均衡聚合，构建归一化的异方差z统计量平均，并通过模拟研究验证方法性能。
AI.findings: 模拟结果显示，在典型情况下（处理期较少，每批观测值较少或较多），该方法能有效控制拒绝率，构建渐近有效的置信区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自适应实验中的因果推断提供了新的统计框架，扩展了异方差条件下的检验统计量理论，解决了自适应实验设计带来的统计推断挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学研究者和其他领域实践者提供了实用的统计工具，能够在自适应实验设计中有效进行因果推断，支持决策制定和政策评估。

title: Tourism as a Driver of Economic Transformation: Pathways Toward Sustainable and Inclusive Growth in the Maldives
affiliations: and Industrial Research

detail.title: Tourism as a Driver of Economic Transformation: Pathways Toward Sustainable and Inclusive Growth in the Maldives
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of tourism as a catalyst for economic transformation in the Maldives, a small island developing state where tourism constitutes the backbone of national income, employment, and foreign exchange. Over the past four decades, the sector has evolved from a luxury niche market into a diversified and resilient component of the Maldivian economy. Drawing on policy analysis, institutional reports, and comparative evidence, the study explores how tourism has driven infrastructure expansion, human capital development, and regional integration. It also highlights the growing emphasis on sustainability and inclusiveness as core pillars of national development strategies. The findings suggest that while tourism has successfully propelled economic growth, it also poses environmental and social challenges-ranging from ecosystem degradation to spatial inequality. The paper argues that achieving long-term resilience requires embedding green innovation, local empowerment, and climate adaptation into the tourism model. The Maldivian case provides valuable insights into how small economies can leverage tourism for sustainable and inclusive transformation in a globalized world.

AI.tldr: 马尔代夫作为小岛屿发展中国家，旅游业已成为其国民收入、就业和外汇的支柱产业。该研究探讨了旅游业如何从奢侈品市场演变为多元化、有韧性的经济组成部分，并分析其对基础设施、人力资本和区域一体化的推动作用，同时指出环境和社会挑战，提出将绿色创新、地方赋权和气候适应纳入旅游模式以实现长期韧性。
AI.research_question: 旅游业如何作为马尔代夫经济转型的催化剂，推动可持续和包容性发展？
AI.motivation: 马尔代夫作为小岛屿发展中国家，旅游业是其经济支柱，研究旅游业如何驱动经济转型对于理解小经济体在全球化背景下实现可持续发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济发展转型理论、可持续旅游理论、小岛屿发展中国家发展理论、包容性增长理论
AI.method: 政策分析、机构报告分析、比较证据研究
AI.findings: 旅游业成功推动了马尔代夫的经济增长，驱动了基础设施扩张、人力资本发展和区域一体化，但也带来了生态系统退化和空间不平等等环境和社会挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为小岛屿发展中国家的经济转型理论提供了实证案例，丰富了可持续旅游和包容性发展的理论框架，提出了将绿色创新、地方赋权和气候适应融入旅游模式的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马尔代夫和其他类似小经济体提供了通过旅游业实现可持续和包容性转型的政策建议，强调了将可持续性和包容性作为国家发展战略核心的重要性，为政策制定者提供了具体的实施路径。

title: The Role of Microfinance in Promoting the Economic Sustainability of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs)
affiliations: and Indonesian College of Economics

detail.title: The Role of Microfinance in Promoting the Economic Sustainability of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs)
detail.abstract:
This study aims to examine the influence of accounting understanding, socialization of SAKEMKM, and the perceptions of MSMEs on the implementation of SAK ETAP and SAK EMKM within the MSME environment. In the first study, accounting understanding and socialization of SAK EMKM significantly influenced the implementation of SAK EMKM in Pekanbaru, with the independent variable contributing 79.2%. This study involved 90 MSMEs registered with the Riau Province Cooperatives and SMEs Office. The findings indicate that a good understanding of accounting can improve the quality of financial reports, while effective socialization helps MSMEs understand and apply these standards.

In the second study, conducted in Palembang City, the results showed that MSMEs' perceptions and understanding of accounting significantly impacted the implementation of SAK ETAP. Although the introduction of SAK ETAP did not show a significant impact, this study emphasizes the importance of accounting understanding in supporting appropriate accounting standards. The results of this second study provide valuable insights into accounting policies and practices among MSMEs and demonstrate the need for further support from the government and relevant institutions in socialization and training.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了会计理解、SAKEMKM社会化以及MSMEs认知对SAK ETAP和SAK EMKM在中小微企业中实施的影响。两项研究分别在不同地区进行，结果显示会计理解对标准实施有显著影响，而有效的社会化活动能帮助中小微企业更好地应用这些会计准则。
AI.research_question: 会计理解、SAKEMKM社会化和MSMEs认知如何影响SAK ETAP和SAK EMKM在中小微企业环境中的实施？
AI.motivation: 中小微企业在实施会计准则（SAK ETAP和SAK EMKM）方面面临挑战，需要了解哪些因素影响这些标准的采纳和应用，以便为政策制定和实践提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于会计采纳理论、组织社会化理论和认知行为理论，研究探讨了知识理解、信息传播和主观认知对会计准则实施的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，包含两项独立研究：第一项在Pekanbaru对90家注册中小微企业进行调查；第二项在Palembang City进行类似研究。使用回归分析等统计方法检验变量间关系。
AI.findings: 1. 在Pekanbaru研究中，会计理解和SAK EMKM社会化对标准实施有显著影响（解释力79.2%）；2. 在Palembang研究中，MSMEs认知和会计理解对SAK ETAP实施有显著影响；3. 良好的会计理解能提高财务报告质量；4. 有效的社会化活动有助于标准应用；5. SAK ETAP的引入本身影响不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了会计理解在会计准则采纳中的核心作用；2. 揭示了社会化过程对知识传播和应用的重要性；3. 区分了不同会计准则（SAK ETAP vs SAK EMKM）实施的影响因素差异；4. 为中小微企业会计采纳理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府和相关机构提供了针对性的培训和社会化策略建议；2. 强调了会计教育对中小微企业财务报告质量的重要性；3. 指出了需要针对不同会计准则采取差异化的推广方法；4. 为政策制定者提供了改进中小微企业会计准则实施的实践指导。

reference: NBB WP No. 478
title: Forward guidance and fiscal rules in HANK

detail.title: Forward guidance and fiscal rules in HANK

publicationDetails.journalName: National Bank of Belgium Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: I show that in a canonical HANK model, under a balanced budget fiscal rule, the effect of a nominal interest rate peg is much larger than in a representative agent (RA) model. By contrast, under a standard fiscal rule where tax revenue responds gradually to the debt-to-GDP ratio and depends on economic activity, the effect of forward guidance is mucj weaker than in the RA model and becomes linear in the length of the peg.This result is robust to allowing for countercyclical inequality and income risk, and carries over to a medium scale model with capital.

AI.tldr: 在标准财政规则下，HANK模型中名义利率钉住的效果比RA模型弱得多，且与钉住期限呈线性关系；而在平衡预算财政规则下，HANK模型中的效果比RA模型大得多。
AI.research_question: 在异质性代理人新凯恩斯主义（HANK）模型中，不同财政规则下名义利率钉住政策的效果如何？与代表性代理人（RA）模型相比有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统代表性代理人模型可能无法准确捕捉财政政策与货币政策交互作用对经济的影响，特别是在考虑家庭异质性和不同财政规则时。需要研究HANK框架下财政规则如何改变货币政策效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性代理人新凯恩斯主义（HANK）模型，对比代表性代理人（RA）模型。考虑两种财政规则：平衡预算规则和标准财政规则（税收收入逐步响应债务-GDP比率并依赖经济活动）。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟。构建规范的HANK模型，比较不同财政规则下名义利率钉住政策的效果。进行稳健性检验：考虑反周期不平等和收入风险，扩展到包含资本的中等规模模型。
AI.findings: 1. 在平衡预算财政规则下，HANK模型中名义利率钉住的效果比RA模型大得多。2. 在标准财政规则下，HANK模型中前瞻指引的效果比RA模型弱得多，且与钉住期限呈线性关系。3. 结果对反周期不平等和收入风险具有稳健性，在包含资本的中等规模模型中同样成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了财政规则在决定货币政策效果中的关键作用。2. 证明了HANK与RA模型在货币政策传导机制上的重要差异。3. 为理解财政-货币政策交互作用提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计货币政策时考虑财政规则提供了理论依据。2. 强调了协调财政与货币政策的重要性。3. 为评估不同财政规则下的货币政策效果提供了分析工具。

title: Economic Education in Iraq – An Urgent Necessity for a Stable Future

detail.title: Economic Education in Iraq – An Urgent Necessity for a Stable Future
detail.abstract: This research highlights the importance of economic education in Iraq as an urgent necessity for ensuring a stable and sustainable economic future. The study points out that the lack of economic awareness and knowledge among youth and students poses a significant challenge to national development, affecting individuals’ ability to make sound financial decisions and contribute effectively to the labour market and society. The research also examines current educational policies and proposes strategies to enhance economic content in curricula, while developing students’ critical thinking and financial analysis skills. It concludes that investing in economic education is not optional but a crucial factor in building an economically aware society capable of facing future challenges with confidence and competence.

AI.tldr: 该研究强调伊拉克经济教育的重要性，指出缺乏经济意识和知识阻碍国家发展，并提出通过课程改革和技能培养来增强经济教育。
AI.research_question: 如何通过教育政策和课程改革来增强伊拉克的经济教育，以培养具有经济意识和金融决策能力的公民？
AI.motivation: 伊拉克青年和学生缺乏经济意识和知识，这影响了他们的财务决策能力、劳动力市场参与度，并阻碍了国家发展，因此需要紧急加强经济教育。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济教育理论、人力资本理论、教育政策分析、批判性思维培养理论。
AI.method: 政策分析、文献综述、课程评估、策略建议制定。
AI.findings: 当前伊拉克经济教育不足，青年经济意识薄弱；需要增强课程中的经济内容，培养批判性思维和金融分析技能；投资经济教育对建设经济意识社会至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了经济教育在战后国家发展中的作用理论，强调了经济意识与社会稳定的关系，为发展中国家经济教育政策提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊拉克教育部门提供了具体的课程改革策略，提出了增强经济教育内容的具体方法，为培养具有经济素养的公民提供了实践指导。

reference: FEEM Policy Brief No. 6
title: The Tartar Steppe of Italian Growth: Strategies for Renewal in a Slowing Europe
affiliations: Université de Nice Sophia Antipolis - Groupe de Recherche en Droit, Economie et Gestion (GREDEG) and Université Cote d'Azur

detail.title: The Tartar Steppe of Italian Growth: Strategies for Renewal in a Slowing Europe

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Briefs & FEEM Reports

detail.abstract: Italy's economy has been characterized by a long-standing malaise marked by low growth, stagnant productivity, and high public debt. In recent years, these weaknesses have been compounded by declining real wages, the underutilization and outward migration of skilled labor, widening territorial disparities, and a rise in income and wealth inequality. The country's productive structure remains concentrated in traditional sectors, dominated by small firms, and underrepresented in strategic industries with high potential for productivity gains. Drawing on macroeconomic and sectoral evidence, this policy brief assesses Italy's current position and outlines the measures needed to reverse these trends. It argues for an industrial strategy that combines state-market complementarities, long-term coordination, and polycentric governance, supported by policies to halt real wage decline and reduce inequality, with the aim of rebuilding productive capacity and ensuring broadly shared prosperity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了意大利经济的长期疲软问题，包括低增长、生产力停滞、高公共债务，以及近年来的实际工资下降、人才外流、地区差距扩大和收入不平等加剧。文章提出需要制定结合国家与市场互补、长期协调和多中心治理的产业战略，以重建生产能力并确保广泛共享的繁荣。
AI.research_question: 意大利经济长期疲软的根源是什么？如何通过产业战略和政策干预来逆转低增长、生产力停滞、不平等加剧等负面趋势？
AI.motivation: 意大利经济长期面临增长乏力、生产力停滞、高公共债务等问题，近年来又出现实际工资下降、人才外流、地区差距扩大和收入不平等加剧等新挑战。这些结构性弱点威胁到国家的经济稳定和社会凝聚力，需要系统性的政策干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于产业战略理论、国家-市场互补性理论、长期协调理论和多中心治理理论，强调需要综合性的政策框架来应对结构性经济问题。
AI.method: 采用宏观经济和部门层面的证据分析，评估意大利当前的经济状况，并基于政策分析提出解决方案。
AI.findings: 意大利经济结构仍集中在传统部门，由小型企业主导，在具有高生产力增长潜力的战略性产业中代表性不足。这些问题导致了低增长、生产力停滞、实际工资下降、人才外流、地区差距扩大和收入不平等等多重挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合国家-市场互补性、长期协调和多中心治理的综合性产业战略框架，为应对结构性经济问题提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为意大利政府提供了具体的政策建议：制定产业战略以重建生产能力；采取措施遏制实际工资下降；减少不平等；促进战略性产业发展；确保广泛共享的繁荣。

title: Biodiversity preferences in urban environments: Full and partial choice experiment profiles with participatory GIS
affiliations: , University of Reading - School of Agriculture, Policy & Development - Department of Agricultural and Food Economics,  and University of Manchester, Economics, Univ.  of Manchester -- Economics & Wageningen University --Mansholt Graduate School of Social Sciences

detail.title: Biodiversity preferences in urban environments: Full and partial choice experiment profiles with participatory GIS
detail.abstract: Biodiversity policies have emerged around the world to address the losses to nature from economic and urban development. In this paper, we aim to determine residents’ preferences for increased biodiversity as part of urban (re)developments, where they want to experience more biodiversity, and the extent in which their preferences differentiate by species. The empirical approach incorporates a comparison of full and partial attribute profiles in a split-sample discrete choice experiment (DCE) with Participatory Geographic Information Systems (PGIS) heat map debriefing questions. Our application is for Greater Manchester, United Kingdom against the background of the Biodiversity Net Gain policy (BNG) in England. We investigate attribute attendance, magnitude changes in mean estimates and follow up with covariate interaction effects on attributes using sociodemographic characteristics and PGIS derived distance variables. Our results indicate partial profiles enhance attribute attendance and the magnitudes of mean estimates vary between the full and partial profiles, but the order of preferences are relatively stable as the species with the highest and lowest mean estimates remain unchanged. In doing so we add to a strand of literature on people’s environmental preferences comparing full and partial profiles with the addition of practical and novel insights on self-reported location preferences. The mean estimates and location preferences are useful in the given BNG policy context to inform authorities and housing developers on residents’ preferences and locations for species enhancement. This in turn can help define priorities for urban green measure selection and land-use planning in the longer term.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过离散选择实验和参与式GIS，调查了英国大曼彻斯特地区居民对城市生物多样性增强的偏好，包括物种选择和地点偏好，为生物多样性净增益政策提供决策依据。
AI.research_question: 居民对城市（再）开发中增加生物多样性的偏好是什么？他们希望在何处体验更多生物多样性？他们的偏好是否因物种而异？
AI.motivation: 全球生物多样性政策旨在应对经济和城市发展对自然造成的损失，但需要了解居民的具体偏好以有效实施政策，特别是在英国生物多样性净增益政策的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境偏好理论、离散选择实验理论、属性参与理论、参与式地理信息系统理论
AI.method: 采用分样本离散选择实验，比较完整属性配置和部分属性配置，结合参与式GIS热图汇报问题，分析属性参与度、均值估计变化，并通过社会人口特征和PGIS距离变量进行协变量交互效应分析。
AI.findings: 部分属性配置增强了属性参与度，完整和部分配置的均值估计大小存在差异，但偏好顺序相对稳定（最高和最低均值估计的物种保持不变）。研究提供了居民对物种增强的具体偏好和位置信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了比较完整和部分属性配置的环境偏好文献，增加了关于自我报告位置偏好的实践性和新颖见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国生物多样性净增益政策背景下，为当局和住房开发商提供居民对物种增强的偏好和位置信息，有助于确定城市绿色措施选择和长期土地利用规划的优先事项。

detail.abstract:
India’s Freedom Struggle would remain incomplete without acknowledging the invaluable participation and sacrifices of women. Many people are ignorant of the fact that women in India fought with males against British rule, forgoing domestic duties and family life in order to secure the country's independence. Their bravery, tenacity, and selflessness served as an inspiration to future generations working for justice and equality. It is impossible to write the history of the Indian National Movement without mentioning these women, whose sacrifices play a vital role in the story of India's liberation.

When most male leaders were imprisoned, women came forward with fearless determination, enduring torture, hardship, and exploitation to sustain the struggle. The historical accounts of a number of Tamil Nadu women liberation warriors are examined in the article "Capsule of Biographies of Unsung Heroines." These include Asalambikai Ammaiyar, who composed Gandhi Puranam songs and followed Gandhian Ahimsa; Moovaloor Ramamirtham, who fought to abolish the Devadasi system and founded Uvathi Saranalayam; Thillaiaadi Valliammai, a human rights advocate; Ambujammal, who supported women's education and boycotted foreign goods; V.M. Kothainayaki Ammal, a patriot and publisher of Jeganmohini magazine; K.B. Sundarambal, who sang patriotic songs during the Salt Satyagraha; and T.P. Rajalakshmi, an actress and dramatist committed to Gandhian principles and Tamil social reform.

An overview of some of the unsung heroines of Tamil Nadu's freedom movement is given in this article. By highlighting their bravery, commitment, and contributions to India's independence, it hopes to support scholars and motivate readers. The history of the Indian liberation movement would not be complete without their efforts. An overview of some of the unsung heroines of Tamil Nadu's freedom movement is given in this article. By highlighting their bravery, commitment, and contributions to India's independence, it hopes to support scholars and motivate readers. The history of the Indian liberation movement would not be complete without their efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析泰米尔纳德邦几位被遗忘的女性自由战士的传记，探讨了女性在印度独立运动中的关键作用，揭示了她们在男性领袖被监禁时如何挺身而出，通过不同方式（文学、社会改革、教育、艺术等）为印度独立做出贡献。
AI.research_question: 泰米尔纳德邦被遗忘的女性自由战士在印度独立运动中扮演了什么角色？她们通过哪些具体方式为印度独立事业做出贡献？
AI.motivation: 印度自由斗争的历史叙述往往忽视女性的贡献，许多女性自由战士的英勇事迹被遗忘。本文旨在纠正这一历史偏差，通过挖掘泰米尔纳德邦几位被遗忘的女性英雄的生平，展示她们在独立运动中的关键作用，为历史研究提供新材料，并激励当代读者。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 女性主义历史观：强调女性在历史进程中的能动性和贡献
2. 后殖民研究：关注被殖民者抵抗运动中的边缘群体
3. 社会运动理论：分析社会变革中不同行动者的角色和策略
4. 文化抵抗理论：探讨文学、艺术等文化形式在政治斗争中的作用
AI.method: 传记研究方法：通过收集和分析泰米尔纳德邦七位女性自由战士的历史资料和传记信息，包括Asalambikai Ammaiyar、Moovaloor Ramamirtham、Thillaiaadi Valliammai、Ambujammal、V.M. Kothainayaki Ammal、K.B. Sundarambal和T.P. Rajalakshmi的生平事迹，进行质性分析。

2. 女性通过多种方式参与斗争：文学创作（Gandhi Puranam歌曲）、社会改革（废除Devadasi制度）、人权倡导、教育推广、出版爱国杂志、艺术表演等
